bio: Dr. Shaji Krishnan V. is the Chairman of NABARD, India’s apex development finance institution for agriculture and rural development. With over three decades of experience spanning commercial banking, development finance, rural banking, digital transformation, and financial inclusion, he has played a pivotal role in advancing technology-led development and inclusive finance. At NABARD, he has championed initiatives in fintech engagement, data analytics, climate finance, digitalization, and innovation-driven rural development. He serves on the boards of DICGC, ONDC, and NCDC, and chairs NABVENTURES, NABARD’s venture capital arm supporting agri-tech and rural innovation. A former Board Member of NPCI and former Chairman of Kerala Gramin Bank, Dr. Shaji is widely recognized for his thought leadership on digital public infrastructure, fintech, sustainable finance, and inclusive growth. Dr. Shaji earned a Ph.D. in Finance from IIM Kozhikode and a PGDM in Public Policy from IIM Ahmedabad.

name: Dr. Yanan Wu
bio: Dr. Yanan Wu: Chairman & CEO, Surfin Group: Dr. Yanan Wu is the Chairman and CEO of Surfin Group, a Singapore-based fintech powerhouse operating in 12+ countries across Asia, Africa, and Latin America. A rare blend of scientist, investor, and entrepreneur, Dr. Wu has spent over 26 years at the intersection of global finance, AI, and innovation, working extensively with institutional investors, hedge funds, and innovative fintech products across international markets. With a Ph.D. in Statistical Physics and a background as a nuclear physicist at Los Alamos National Laboratory, Dr. Wu transitioned into global investing before founding Surfin in 2017. Under his leadership, Surfin has become a rapidly expanding ecosystem driven by AI and big data, serving tens of millions of users in emerging markets. Today, the group’s global network reflects Dr. Wu’s vision of combining technology and purpose to reshape the future of inclusive finance.

name: Mr. Abhishek Dwivedi
bio: Abhishek Dwivedi has over 15 years of experience in financial services and fintech, with a proven track record in scaling businesses and driving profitability. He has been associated with the Navi Group since its inception in 2019, and is currently the Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer of Navi Finserv Limited. Previously, he held leadership roles at Navi Limited (formerly Navi Technologies Limited), and at Navi General Insurance. Abhishek is also a former Co-Founder & CEO of Treemendous.in and Vice President at BankBazaar.com. He holds an MBA from S.P. Jain Institute, a Master’s in IT from Virginia Tech - Pamplin College of Business, and a Bachelor’s in Engineering from Punjab Technical University.

name: Mr. Abhishek Gandhi
bio: An entrepreneur at heart and a financial expert by training, FatakPay is the third company that Abhishek has cofounded over the years. Abhishek is a sought after expert in the Financial domain and has landed coverage in broadcast and digital outlets around the country, including the Economic Times, Radio City, Business Standard, The New Indian Standard, DNA India, Money Control, The Week, Financial Express, YourStory and Inc42 to name a few. More recently, he was awarded the '40 Under 40 for the year 2020' by IAAIF and 101 Top most influential BFSI leaders and 'India's inspiring leaders' award 2021 by ELETS. Abhishek holds a CFA and an MBA from Erasmus University, a BE in Comp Science and has 18+ Yrs of experience in Financial consulting & strategy with Infosys, Nidera and Kalpataru Group.

name: Mr. Abhishek Poddar
bio: I am an entrepreneurial and impact-driven product leader with 22+ years of experience building and scaling fintech, digital payments and commerce products across India, Latin America and global markets. I have been fortunate to build ngpay, be part of the founding team at Ezetap, and launch Cashi, Walmart’s digital financial services business in Mexico. Today, as Chief Product Officer at the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH), I am focused on building digital public infrastructure that can create meaningful impact at scale. I enjoy solving complex problems, building products that matter, and making hard things work.

name: Mr. Abhishek Saraf
bio: Abhishek Saraf brings over 25 years of insurance experience within the Prudential ecosystem, spanning actuarial, risk, capital management, and enterprise leadership roles. Prior to taking over as COO of Prudential Health India, he was the Group Chief Actuary and played a pivotal role in shaping Prudential's actuarial strategy, strengthening governance frameworks, and providing oversight on complex risk and capital decisions across global markets. Throughout his career, Abhishek has been instrumental in navigating evolving regulatory landscapes, driving capital efficiency, and supporting strategic transactions that enable sustainable growth. His deep expertise and global perspective continue to contribute to Prudential's long-term resilience and success.

name: Mr. Abhishek Saxena
bio: Abhishek Saxena is the Founder of OmniCard and Managing Director of Taisys India, with over 19 years of experience in business and technology. An IIT-BHU alumnus, he has worked with global majors like HTC (Taiwan) and Samsung, and holds 8 patents in advanced technologies, including artificial intelligence. He is driving innovations in digital payments, fleet spend management, and IoT-led financial solutions for enterprises.

name: Mr. Adeeb Ahamed
bio: Adeeb Ahamed is the Managing Director of LuLu Financial Holdings, a leading financial services company operating across the GCC, India and APAC, driving innovation in cross-border payments and digital financial solutions. He also leads Twenty14 Holdings, an investment firm with a diversified portfolio in luxury hospitality. A prominent voice on digital innovation and financial inclusion, Mr. Ahamed actively contributes to global economic discourse through platforms such as the World Economic Forum. He occupies several leadership positions, including Chair of FICCI's Middle East Council and Board Member of the UAE International Investors Council. He is also a member of The Wall Street Journal CEO Council and the Washington Post Intelligence Council, reflecting his growing influence in global business, economic and policy discourse.

name: Mr. Aditya Agarwal
bio: Aditya Agarwal is the Co-founder of Wealthy.in, India’s leading wealth-tech platform for mutual fund distributors and wealth professionals. He brings experience across capital markets, investment research and business strategy. Before founding Wealthy.in, he helped grow his family business fivefold and advised Fortune 500 companies during his tenure at Monitor Group. He is an alumnus of IIT Bombay. Wealthy.in works with over 10,000 Wealth Partners and mutual fund distributors serving more than 1,00,000 clients across 1,000+ pin codes

name: Mr. Aditya Bhamidipaty
bio: Aditya is the Founder and CEO of FirstHive, a global Customer Data Platform (CDP) company. He is a seasoned technology entrepreneur with a track record of solving marketing challenges using advanced technology. Aditya began his career at Procter & Gamble, where he successfully turned around a lossmaking region into a profitable, high-growth area. He later worked at iGate in Europe before co-founding Emart Solutions, one of India's leading loyalty and engagement companies, which he exited in 2015. Since founding FirstHive in 2016, Aditya has scaled the company into one of the few fullstack AI-powered CDPs globally. Today, FirstHive enables enterprises to achieve significant improvements in marketing ROI through hyper-personalized customer experiences powered by data and AI.

name: Mr. Aditya Khullar
bio: Aditya Khullar is the Managing Director of Adyen India, leading the company’s growth and strategy in one of the world’s fastest-growing digital payments markets. Since launching Adyen’s India business, he has built the company into a trusted payments partner for many of the world’s leading enterprises, helping them navigate India’s unique payments ecosystem while scaling globally. Prior to Adyen, Aditya held senior commercial leadership roles across Asia Pacific with SWISS International Air Lines. He brings over 20 years of experience in payments, technology, digital commerce and international business.

name: Mr. Aditya Singh
bio: Aditya Singh is a seasoned entrepreneur with over 20 years of expertise spanning EV and mobility technology, financing, consulting, banking and business development. As the Co-founder & CEO of TapFin, he is driving innovative solutions across technology and financing, to accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles in India. An MBA graduate from XLRI Jamshedpur and an IT graduate from Delhi University, Aditya co-founded CreditMate, successfully leading it for five years until its acquisition by Paytm. His professional journey includes pivotal roles in data science, strategy consulting, international banking and payments at organizations like EY, KPMG, Cedar Consulting, and ICICI Bank. With a data-driven mindset and a proven track record of building enterprises from scratch and delivering results, Aditya is at the forefront of advancing EV technology and financing solutions across India, leveraging his diverse experience to create sustainable and scalable impact.

name: Mr. Ajay Agarwal
jobTitle: Company Secretary and Group Head – Secretarial & Group Oversight
bio: Mr. Agarwal is the Company Secretary and Group Head – Secretarial and Group Oversight at HDFC Bank Limited. A seasoned governance professional with over 28 years of experience, he has led complex mergers and corporate restructurings, including the landmark merger of HDFC Ltd. with HDFC Bank. He is an expert in corporate and securities law, governance, and regulatory compliance, and also serves as the Compliance Officer of HDFC Bank, under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. Mr. Agarwal is a Fellow Member of ICSI, a law graduate, has contributed to several Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) committees and has been a member of certain SEBI working groups/ Committees. Mr. Agarwal continues to contribute meaningfully to the governance and regulatory ecosystem through his role, industry engagements and participation in key policy shaping forums.

name: Mr. Ajay Thomas John
bio: Mr. Ajay Thomas John is the Group Chief Digital Officer at Shriram Capital, leading enterprise-wide digital transformation across the Shriram Group's financial services businesses. With over 22 years of experience in banking, fintech, and digital innovation, he has spearheaded large-scale initiatives spanning digital lending, payments, AI, customer experience, and platform transformation. Previously, he held leadership roles at Bajaj Finance, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and CitiFinancial, and is recognized for driving technology-led business growth and innovation across the BFSI sector.

name: Mr. Ajinkya Kulkarni
bio: Ajinkya Kulkarni is the Co-founder and CEO of Wint Wealth, a leading Indian fixed-income investment platform focused on democratizing access to bonds for retail investors. Wint has enabled over 400,000 investors to access fixed-income products and has facilitated more than ₹10,000 crore in investments. He also leads Ambium Finserve, an RBI-regulated NBFC, and actively contributes to industry policy through the Online Bond Platform Providers Association (OBPP). Ajinkya is passionate about leveraging technology to broaden access to savings, investments, and credit.

name: Mr. Akash Sinha
bio: Akash Sinha is the CEO & Co-founder of Cashfree Payments, India’s leading AI-native payments infrastructure and intelligence platform that empowers businesses with seamless digital payment solutions. A tech enthusiast, Akash’s approach to innovation revolves around leveraging technology to solve real-world challenges, creating substantial value, and enabling businesses to scale faster and more effectively.

name: Mr. Akhil Devmurari
jobTitle: FinTech Sector Head, Asia Pacific, J.P. Morgan Payments
bio: Akhil Devmurari serves as the Fintech Sector Head at J.P. Morgan Payments, bringing unparalleled expertise and a forward-thinking approach to this ever-evolving segment. With a proven track record of driving business growth and building lasting client relationships, Akhil brings a strategic and client-centric approach to the team. With a keen understanding of both financial services and technological advancements, Akhil has successfully led coverage teams to capitalize on emerging opportunities in the rapidly evolving fintechs & digital assets landscape in APAC. His passion for innovation and commitment to delivering tailored solutions make him an instrumental leader in positioning J.P. Morgan as a key player in the intersection of finance and technology.

name: Mr. Akshat Birla
bio: Akshat Birla is the Founder & CEO of BharatNXT, a fintech platform driving financial inclusion for India’s small businesses. A serial entrepreneur, Akshat earlier built Finovate Capital, a supply chain financing fintech, and spearheaded Samsung Pay’s global expansion into 20+ countries, including India. His career spans supply chain (i2), banking (Credit Suisse), and corporate strategy in Samsung’s Chairman’s Office, Korea HQ. He is also an active angel investor and Leads INSEAD Angels India.

name: Mr. Akshat Mathur
bio: Akshat Mathur is a seasoned expert in cross-border growth and financial infrastructure, specialising in helping businesses navigate global expansion. As Head of Account Management for India at Unlimit, he empowers organisations to reach their potential in global markets, including India, APAC, LATAM and beyond. A recognised industry thought leader and frequent speaker at premier events, such as the Global Fintech Fest 2025, Akshat focuses on the intersection of emerging technologies, payments, AI and the borderless agentic economy. His 12-year career includes pivotal roles at dLocal, Microsoft, and HP, where he developed deep expertise in mapping hyper-local ecosystems into scalable, primary-layer growth strategies.

name: Mr. Akshay Mehrotra
bio: Akshay Mehrotra, Co-founder & Group CEO of Fibe, has built the company into one of India’s most profitable fintech enterprises. With a mission to enhance young India’s financial well-being, he has scaled Fibe to 25M+ users and disbursed ₹33,000 crore+ in loans. He combines strategic foresight with a deep understanding of consumer behaviour, honed over two decades in leadership roles, making him a key voice in digital lending.

name: Mr. Akshay Yadava
org: Unique Identification Authority of India , MeITY
bio: Akshay Yadava is a distinguished government affairs and public policy leader, serving as Director at the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Regional Office, Mumbai. An alumnus of IIM Calcutta specialising in Fintech and Financial Blockchain, he brings extensive cross-sector experience across the Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Home Affairs and MeitY. At the helm of India's digital identity transformation, he steers Aadhaar-led Digital Benefit Transfers, champions Face Authentication in the BFSI sector, shapes the Offline Verification Seeking Entity (OVSE) framework redefining secure, paperless financial onboarding. A recognised voice in fintech, identity governance and cybersecurity, Akshay partners with regulators, banks and technology players to architect robust frameworks for identity-based fraud prevention, strengthening India's Digital Public Infrastructure, advancing financial inclusion and reinforcing secure, citizen-centric governance across the Western Region.

name: Mr. Alexander Bruce
jobTitle: Head of International Strategic Priorities Advocacy

name: Mr. Alexandre Stervinou
bio: Alexandre Stervinou is currently Director in the Cash and Retail Payments Policy and Oversight Directorate at the Banque de France, a 55+ staff directorate in charge of strategic policy, oversight and security of all types of retail payments, with a focus on fostering innovations in those fields (e.g. CBDC with the digital euro). The Directorate also has a direct responsibility on cash anti-counterfeiting matters. Prior to this, Alexandre held a Deputy Director role in the Market Infrastructures and Innovations Directorate and, between 2019 and 2021, he was a member of the Financial Stability Board (FSB) Secretariat, where he mostly dealt with innovation related matters on the G20 agenda for financial services, and more specifically on cutting-edge topics such as cross-border payments, cybersecurity, crypto-assets and stablecoins, BigTechs, cloud services, artificial intelligence and machine learning.

name: Mr. Alok Mittal
bio: Alok is Co-founder and Executive Chairman of Indifi, India's leading full-stack platform for enabling debt financing for small businesses. Alok is also an active angel investor, and currently on the Global Board of The Indus Entrepreneurs.

name: Mr. Ambar Sur
bio: Ambar Sur is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of TerraPay, a global digital payments infrastructure company established in 2015. With over two decades of experience across telecommunications, technology and mobile payments, he has played a pivotal role in expanding TerraPay’s presence across Africa, Europe, Asia and other global markets. Before founding TerraPay, Ambar spent more than 13 years at Comviva Technologies, where he served as Whole-time Director and Senior Vice President. He previously founded CellCloud Technologies, a prepaid solutions company that later merged with Mahindra Comviva. He began his career with LCC in Washington, D.C., working on wireless networks worldwide, before joining BPL Mobile in India. Ambar holds an MS in Electrical Engineering from New York University and a bachelor’s degree from Virginia Tech. Outside work, he is an avid reader and enjoys music and travel.

name: Mr. Amir Nagammy
bio: AMIR NAGAMMY is an entrepreneur and investor with extensive international experience and expertise in emerging markets (particularly the CIS, Middle East, Africa, and India). He has a twenty-five year record in launching and running start-ups across multiple industry sectors across the globe, transforming them into profitable, large-scale businesses that consistently produce impressive returns for their stakeholders. Having worked in highly complex regional environments, Amir is respected for his crisis management skills in fast-changing situations and for his extensive background in deal structuring. He is able to fulfil a portfolio of management roles with cross-industry capabilities, including fundraising, project finance, and management, trading and business development. He is currently a Co-Founder and Chairman of Prism Group AG and Global Fintech Investments Holding AG.

name: Mr. Amirali Zubin Valliani
bio: Amir Valliani joined PayPal in 2025 and is the Vice President for Middle East and Africa, Southeast Asia, India and Korea at PayPal. He oversees all commercial aspects of PayPal’s business and leads strategic growth initiatives across these markets.

name: Mr. Amit Kumar
bio: Amit Kumar is the CTO and Executive Director of Easebuzz, an RBI-authorised Payment Aggregator, where he drives technology, product innovation and the company’s vision for building the next generation of financial infrastructure. With 18 years of experience across technology, banking and fintech, he brings deep expertise in payments, data, AI and scalable technology platforms. Amit believes that “Verticalization-over-Payments” is the way forward to create greater value by combining embedded payments with intelligent, domain-specific financial workflows. He is focused on leveraging AI and data-led technology to make financial services more intelligent, accessible and deeply embedded, while building trusted and compliant infrastructure for the evolving digital economy.

name: Mr. Amit Talwar
bio: Professional with over 27 years of experience across 2 mainstream commercial banks with rich experience of Transaction Banking Products (Cross Border & Domestic Payments, Cash Management Services, Trade Finance & Trade Services) as well as Retail Banking (Liabilities & Assets). Now working with a licensed non-bank, tech-driven entity with focus on FOREX products & Solutions

name: Mr. Amitabh Chaudhry
bio: Amitabh Chaudhry is the MD&CEO of Axis Bank. In a long and distinguished career, Amitabh has been unafraid to take risks, challenge norms and push the boundaries of conventional thinking across industries. Amitabh runs Axis Bank, a financial conglomerate, together with a world class leadership team and a clearly defined vision of being a bank that fulfils the aspirations of a new, resurgent India through smart banking solutions.

name: Mr. Amitava Chatterjee
bio: Mr. Amitava Chatterjee is the second MD & CEO of Jammu and Kashmir Bank Limited. Mr. Chatterjee was Deputy Managing Director, SBI and has also served as MD&CEO of SBICAPS. Mr. Chatterjee has an illustrious career in banking spanning over more than three decades in diverse geographical locations and strategic positions. His diverse experience includes heading the SBI’s operation as CGM New Delhi, circle and Jaipur Circle with high end clientele like PSUs, NBFCs, and DISCOMs. He has shouldered responsibilities that included Business Development, Risk & Compliance Management, HR Functions with his previous employer besides interacting and participating in various Industry and Government forums. He has completed his Master’s in Business Administration from ICFAI University Hyderabad besides having qualified the CAIIB offered by IIBF. Beyond his professional pursuits, he is a passionate sports enthusiast and follows tennis, football and cricket.

name: Mr. Anand Agarwal
jobTitle: Executive Director, Head - Cash Product, India
bio: With over 25 years of experience in banking, I specialize in payments, product management and development, and client solutioning. My work spans managing complex projects related to payments and settlement systems. Driven by a passion for continual learning, I actively explore new products, processes, and trends within the financial services sector.

name: Mr. Anchal Jajodia
bio: Anchal Jajodia is the Co-founder of Cybrilla, where he leads the company's business and strategic partnerships. Under his leadership, Cybrilla partnered with ONDC to launch India's first decentralized mutual fund distribution network, bringing together 30+ mutual funds and 140+ digital distributors on a single open network. More recently, Cybrilla partnered with NCDEX to power its mutual fund platform and mutual fund clearing infrastructure. Anchal works closely with asset managers, financial institutions, exchanges, and ecosystem partners to build the next generation of investment infrastructure in India.

name: Mr. Anirudh Arun
bio: Left college to build Agentic Universe; scaled an earlier product to $22M annual GMV in 18 months before pivoting to enterprise AI agents, now past $1M+ ARR.

name: Mr. Anjani Kumar Rathor
jobTitle: Group Head - Digital and Customer Experience
bio: Anjani Rathor is the Group Head for Digital and Customer Experience at HDFC Bank. He heads Digital Banking, Customer Experience, Data and Process Excellence at the Bank. Anjani joined HDFC Bank in 2020. Prior to joining the Bank, he worked with Bharti Airtel and served as the Chief Information Officer (CIO) of Airtel's Consumer Business. An industry veteran with over 20+ years of experience, Anjani brings with him rich and diverse experience across sectors such as Banking, Telecom, Consulting and Aviation. Anjani holds a degree in Bachelor of Technology from IIT Kharagpur and a Post Graduate Diploma in Management from IIM Calcutta..

name: Mr. Ankit Durga
bio: Ankit Durga is the Founder and CEO of Fundamento, where he is building the infrastructure layer for how financial institutions engage, qualify, convert, and retain customers through AI-native communication systems. Under his leadership, Fundamento has evolved beyond voice automation into an outcome-driven agentic AI platform purpose-built for banks, NBFCs, and fintechs - combining multilingual voice intelligence, journey orchestration, and propensity-led decisioning to help enterprises improve speed-to-contact, operational efficiency, and lifecycle performance across the lending funnel. A serial entrepreneur with over a decade of experience, Ankit co-founded Leap Skills before pivoting to build Fundamento, driven by the conviction that AI could unlock access to financial services at the last mile. He is an alumnus of Harvard's Executive Program and an INK Fellow.

name: Mr. Ankit Jain
jobTitle: Group Head of Product- Inperson payment and currency solutions
bio: Payment professional with over 20 years of experience working in MNC banks and payment companies

name: Mr. Antriksh Parmar
bio: Antriksh Parmar is Vice President – Financial Services at ONDC, where he leads the Credit vertical and is building open, interoperable digital infrastructure for lending in India. He has over 13 years of experience across SaaS and fintech, having previously worked at Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Atlassian, and high-growth startups. At ONDC, he focuses on enabling scalable, inclusive credit through open network standards and ecosystem collaboration

name: Mr. Anubrata Biswas
bio: Anubrata Biswas, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Airtel Payments Bank, is an industry stalwart with over two decades of experience in banking and financial services. In his current role, he has been instrumental in shaping the Bank's journey in India's digital banking landscape. Under his leadership, Airtel Payments Bank has emerged as the largest Payments Bank in the country. The Bank has built a strong portfolio of businesses, with sustained profitability since FY22. Today, the Bank is one of the fastest-growing digital bank in the country. He serves on leading industry bodies and is currently the co-chair of the Payments Bank committee by the Payments Council of India (PCI) and a member of the FICCI National Committee on Fintech and CII National Committee on Banking. In the past, Anubrata has been the co-chair of the CII Financial Inclusion and Fintech Committee for FY24 and the Co-Chair of the CII Task Force on Fintech for FY 21.

name: Mr. Anupam Vasdani
bio: As Chief Financial Officer of True Balance, Anupam Vasdani drives the financial strategy and fiscal health of the company’s expanding digital ecosystem. With over 20 years of expertise in corporate finance, treasury management, and fundraising, he builds the structural foundation necessary for large-scale growth. Anupam balances disciplined financial planning with modern risk management, using AI to optimize asset-liability management and market forecasting. Previously, as CFO at Toyota Financial Services India, Anupam led a robust funding unit raising ₹200 billion annually via NCDs, commercial paper, and offshore markets. His career features key roles at Habitat Housing Finance, Deutsche Postbank Home Finance, and FiNoble Advisors, overseeing treasury operations and private equity advisory. A Chartered Accountant (ICAI), Anupam blends institutional expertise with fintech agility. He ensures seamless capital flows and regulatory compliance, providing financial stability to scale operations across India.

name: Mr. Apoorva Goyal
bio: Apoorva Goyal is a Principal at Insight Partners, a global software investor, which he joined in 2021. He invests in high-growth fintech, internet, and software companies from Series A through pre-IPO, with a particular focus on helping Indian SaaS and tech startups build for global markets. He has led or served on the boards of investments including Yubi, M2P, Chargebee, and Slice, and partners closely with founders on product, finance, and strategy.

name: Mr. Arindam Banerrji
jobTitle: Executive Vice President & Country Head India

name: Mr. Arindam Das
bio: Arindam Das currently serves as the CEO of DMI Finance Pvt. Ltd. He joined in January 2017. He launched DMI Finance’s Retail lending business which is Consumer and MSME Finance, making DMI one of the largest digital lending NBFCs in the country today in terms of disbursed loans and customers acquired. Additionally, he sits on the board of DMI’s Payment Business (Appnit Technologies) and is an Investment Committee Member of DMI's Venture Capital Fund (Sparkle). Before joining DMI Finance, he held leadership positions at Capital First, IIFL Finance Merrill Lynch and Citigroup. He also co-founded an on-demand local services marketplace. He is post graduate in Business Management from K J Somaiya Institute of Management, Mumbai, and a graduate degree in Economics, he brings over two decades of experience across Business Development, Credit and Risk Management, Product, Distribution, and Operations

name: Mr. Arun Kohli
jobTitle: Managing Director and Country Head of India

name: Mr. Ashish Kashyap
bio: Ashish Kashyap is a serial technology entrepreneur and the Founder of INDmoney, a leading wealth management and investment App. INDmoney empowers users to track and grow their NetWorth and at the same time enables investments across US and Indian markets from a single platform. Prior to launching INDmoney in 2019, Ashish previously founded leading travel group, ibibo Group (Goibibo, redBus) and payments fintech platform PayU India. Ashish is also an x-Googler.

name: Mr. Ashish Runwal
bio: Mr. Ashish Runwal is a visionary business leader with a distinguished career spanning banking, financial services and business transformation. Having led organizations through growth and change, he has been instrumental in building multiple business verticals, launching innovative lending solutions and scaling high performing teams across sales, credit, operations and strategy. His leadership has driven profitable growth, strengthened governance, optimized operational efficiency and forged strategic partnerships that create long term value. Renowned for converting vision into execution, he has successfully built businesses from the ground up, spearheaded market expansion initiatives and championed technology led transformation. With a leadership philosophy rooted in innovation, customer trust and sustainable growth, he continues to inspire teams, shape industry excellence and create meaningful impact across the financial ecosystem.

name: Mr. Ashok Chandra
bio: Shri Ashok Chandra assumed charge as Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer of Punjab National Bank on 16th January 2025 bringing over 34 years of rich banking experience Prior to his current assignment, Shri Chandra was Executive Director of Canara Bank. In this capacity, he has overseen various Verticals including Digital Banking and Information Technology, Strategy and Planning, Marketing,Financial Inclusion, MSME, Retail Asset,etc. He was also a Director in the Board of Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited, PSB Alliance Ltd. and Canara Venture Capital Fund Ltd . Earlier, as Chief General Manager at Union Bank of India, he headed the Recovery, Legal, and Stressed Asset Management Vertical and served on the Board of NARCL Shri Chandra holds a Master’s in Economics and is also a Certified Associate of Indian Institute of Bankers. He was chosen to be a part of the leadership programme designed by the Banks Board Bureau and conducted by IIM Bangalore during 2019-2020.

name: Mr. Atis Ivanovs
bio: Atis Ivanovs is Head of Business Growth for Europe and the UK at Unlimit. With over a decade of experience across sales, finance, customer care, and e-payment processes, he has held key roles in the financial sector, including at Citadele Banka and Amway Europe. Since joining Unlimit in 2020, Atis has served in various positions – including Business Growth Lead, Senior Customer Success Manager, and Client Relations Manager – playing a vital role in the company’s expansion across the European market. His expertise in cross-border payment challenges and alternative payment methods has been highlighted in industry discussions. In addition to speaking at the iFX Expo Dubai, Atis is a regular attendee at leading international fintech events such as Money20/20, Shoptalk, Consensus, and Mobile World Congress (MWC), where he keeps up with the latest trends and innovations in the industry.

name: Mr. Avinash Karn
bio: Avinash Karn is Senior Director of AI Strategy at PayPal, where he leads AI strategy and engineering within PayPal's central AI group and builds AI products — both customer facing and internal — that shape how the company operates in the age of Agentic AI. His portfolio spans Business AI Transformation programs that tie AI investment to measurable business outcomes; Agentic Commerce, positioning PayPal as the economic operating system for the agent economy; an AI Fluency Index measuring enterprise adoption maturity; and foundational AI Research advancing PayPal's frontier AI capabilities. A first-principles, frameworks-driven leader, Avinash sits at PayPal's leadership table on AI positioning and competitive strategy, and shapes academic and industry dialogue across India on the future of AI-native enterprises.

name: Mr. Balaji Koustubha
bio: Balaji Koustubha is the Founder and CEO of CredResolve, an Indian technology company redefining collections in one of the most misunderstood corners of financial services. An IIT Roorkee alumnus, Balaji spent his earlier years at WheelsEye building unsecured credit lines for retail fleet owners and supply-chain financing for SMEs, an experience that seeded his conviction that technology could transform India's most fragmented, operationally heavy corners of credit.

name: Mr. Basu Agarwal
bio: Basu Agarwal is the Founder & CEO of Simplifin.ai, an AI-powered wealthtech platform focused on democratizing mutual fund distribution through ONDC and the latest technology stack. With over a decade of experience in fintech and AI, he has built and delivered digital AI solutions for multiple leading financial institutions and fintech companies. He is driving the next generation of mutual fund infrastructure by leveraging AI, open digital networks, and intelligent automation to enable seamless investing at scale. Basu's vision is to make mutual fund investing accessible to every corner of India, empowering distributors, advisors, and digital platforms to reach millions of underserved investors. He believes AI will play a transformative role in helping individuals achieve their financial goals through personalized, inclusive, and technology-driven wealth management.

name: Mr. Benjamin Lee
bio: Benjamin Lee is the Interim Chief Operating Officer of Nexus Global Payments (NGP), where he leads the operationalisation of Nexus, a pioneering multilateral arrangement connecting domestic fast payment systems for seamless cross-border payments. Involved from inception, he previously served as Product Owner and Implementation Lead, helping progress Nexus from a BIS Innovation Hub experiment into a Singapore-headquartered, not-for-profit company co-owned by participating central banks. Before NGP, Benjamin was a senior member of the BIS Innovation Hub Singapore Centre, including as Acting Centre Head, and held senior roles at the Monetary Authority of Singapore and Ministry of Finance. He was also based in Washington, DC, representing Singapore on the World Bank Group Executive Board. He regularly speaks on payments innovation, cross-border collaboration and financial infrastructure.

name: Mr. Bharat Joshi
bio: Bharat Joshi is the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer at VuNet Systems, where he leads product strategy, customer success, and business operations to deliver impactful observability solutions at scale. With over 25 years of experience in building secure, scalable software for infrastructure, networking, and observability, Bharat blends technical depth with business leadership. Before VuNet, Bharat was part of Infosys, with expertise spanning software architecture, project leadership, and product development. He is a co-founder of the India Internet Engineering Society (IIESoc) and an active contributor to the IETF, with several RFCs to his credit. Bharat is also a frequent speaker at industry forums and panel events, and he hosts VuNet’s podcast “Observability Talk.” An Electrical Engineering graduate from HBTI Kanpur, Bharat remains passionate about using technology to solve complex business problems while contributing actively to open-source and standards communities.

name: Mr. Bhavin Patel
bio: Bhavin Patel is the Co-Founder & CEO of Vartis Platforms, the parent of LenDenClub, InstaMoney, and Vartis One. With over a decade of experience in the lending domain, he has built one of India's most trusted and innovative fintech ecosystems. Journey & Achievements Pioneered Peer-to-Peer Lending in India: Built LenDenClub, now the country's leading RBI-regulated NBFC-P2P platform. Driving Financial Inclusion: Created access to credit for thousands of underserved borrowers while enabling lakhs of investors to diversify into alternate assets. Profitability & Scale: Led the company to become EBITDA positive in 4 of the last 5 years, achieving 236 cr in revenue and 34 cr PAT in FY25. Innovation in Lending: Developed a proprietary AI-driven credit assessment model using 600+ data points, ensuring NPAs consistently below 4%. Diversified Businesses: Expanded into InstaMoney (Loan Service Platform) and Vartis One (Technology Service Provider), serving both consumers and enterprises.

name: Mr. Biju Raj
bio: Biju Raj is the Chief Operating Officer & Head of Strategy at Broadridge India, where he leads business strategy and operations with a focus on driving efficiency, innovation, and sustainable long-term impact. With over 20 years of leadership experience across organizations including Shell, SAP, Al Futtaim, and entrepreneurial ventures in IT consulting and climate technology, he has led multi-billion-dollar transformation programs, built global Centers of Excellence, and leveraged emerging technologies to enhance customer experience and business agility. As the co-founder of climate-tech startup deCarbon AI, Biju brings an entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for sustainability and innovation.

name: Mr. Bikramjeet Singh Ghuman
org: SBI Card and Payment Services Limited
bio: Bikramjeet Ghuman is a senior financial services and payments leader with over two decades of experience spanning product management, payment innovations, revenue management, digital marketing and customer-centric growth. As Executive Vice President at SBI Card, he has played a key role in shaping products, partnerships and innovations that have contributed to the evolution of India’s credit card and payments ecosystem. His experience covers the full spectrum of the payments value chain, with a strong focus on creating differentiated customer propositions and driving sustainable business growth.

name: Mr. Bipin Preet Preet Singh
bio: Bipin Preet Singh is the Managing Director, Co-Founder, and CEO of One MobiKwik Systems Ltd. He founded MobiKwik with a vision to transform the digital payments landscape in India. Bipin is a product enthusiast who loves good tech and smart engineers. He holds a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi, and has 20+ years of experience in technology, payments, and financial services.

name: Mr. Brijesh Singh
jobTitle: Principal Secretary, Directorate of Information & Public Relations

name: Mr. Carlin Crasto
bio: Carlin Crasto is the Chief Technology Officer at 86400, bringing nearly two decades of experience in designing and scaling enterprise-grade digital payments infrastructure. Having progressed through multiple technology leadership roles within the organization, he has been instrumental in architecting high-performance platforms that power secure, resilient, and high-volume payment ecosystems. His expertise spans UPI, IMPS, BBPS, API Banking, cloud-native architecture, enterprise integration, and payment security. As CTO, Carlin leads the company's technology strategy, product architecture, innovation, and engineering teams, driving the development of next-generation payment infrastructure that enables financial institutions to deliver seamless, scalable, and future-ready digital payment experiences.

name: Mr. Challa Sreenivasulu Setty
bio: Mr. Challa Sreenivasulu Setty took over as Chairman of State Bank of India on 28th August 2024. He joined the Board of SBI as Managing Director in January 2020 and headed Retail & Digital Banking, International Banking, Global Markets & Technology verticals. A Bachelor of Science in Agriculture and also, a Certified Associate of Indian Institute of Bankers, he started his career with State Bank of India in 1988 as a Probationary Officer. Across a career spanning over three decades, he has rich experience in Corporate credit, Retail, Digital and International banking and banking in developed markets. Mr. Setty has held key assignments in State Bank of India in Stressed Assets Management, Corporate banking, Mid-Corporate banking, Global Markets and Technology both in India and abroad.

name: Mr. Chandan Khaitan
bio: Chandan Khaitan is a seasoned leader with over 20 years of experience in building successful businesses across FMCG, Retail, Commerce and Financial Services. Chandan is a Harvard Business School alumni and a Chartered Accountant. He specializes in creating technologybased businesses and P&L Management. He has held various leadership positions across the Commerce, Technology, Strategy and Finance domain. He holds the honour of being selected as one of the sixteen high-potential associates globally, across the Walmart International program to develop future leaders, under the direct mentorship of the Walmart International CEO. He has a keen interest in sports and plays tennis regularly, while also being an avid trekker and a mountaineering enthusiast. His previous stints also include working in organizations like Flipkart, Walmart, Reckitt Benckiser Group, Nestle India Ltd. and Perfetti Van Melle.

name: Mr. Chetan Krishnaswamy
bio: Chetan Krishnaswamy is the Vice President of Public Policy at Amazon India, where he leads policy engagement and strategic advocacy across India’s fast-evolving digital economy. With over two decades of experience spanning public policy, corporate affairs, technology, and media, Chetan has held leadership roles at Google, Dell Technologies, and Intel. He is widely recognized for building strong public-private partnerships and for shaping conversations around technology, innovation, and inclusive digital growth in India. Prior to his corporate career, he worked as a journalist covering technology and business.

name: Mr. Christophe Mariette
bio: Christophe Mariette is a Director Partner of Lyra Group. He is also the co-founder and Chairman of Lyra India since 2007. For 20 years, he has been managing the business of Lyra Group and the growth of Lyra in the landscape of innovative and secure payment which is dealing with more than 20 billion payments per year. Thanks to the Lyra’s links between France and India, he has been introducing the Indian Instant payment method UPI in Europe on Iconic places such as Eiffel Tower, Galeries Lafayette, Extime (French Airports), Bicester Village .... Passionate of international development, Christophe Mariette has travelled all around the world to develop Lyra. He has been also nominated French Foreign Trade Adviser by French Prime Minister. Before joining Lyra, he has been working for Thales in R&D and then in international business for telecom and aircraft systems. Christophe Mariette has studied in software and Aircraft engineering schools

name: Mr. D Surendran
bio: Shri D. Surendran is a Post Graduate in Agriculture from Annamalai University and also a Certified Associate of the Indian Institute of Bankers. He has also undergone Leadership Development Programme for Senior Executives by Banks Board Bureau at Indian Institute of Management, Bengaluru.He started his career in Canara Bank as an Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) in the year 1990 and has served the Bank for last 34 years in various capacities in the States of Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, New Delhi and Andhra Pradesh. He has headed Very Large Branches and Exceptionally Large Branches. He has worked as General Manager in Karnataka Gramin Bank and has headed Canara Bank Circle Office, Madurai. His experience includes Branch Banking, Priority Credit, MSME, Retail Credit, Recovery and Human Resources. Currently, he is the Non-Executive Chairman on the Board of PNB Cards and Services Limited and is also on the Board of PNB Housing Finance Limited.

name: Mr. Debiprasad Sarangi
bio: Debiprasad Sarangi is a fintech visionary and payments evangelist, serving as the Co-founder and CEO of iServeU, a leading Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) provider. An engineer by training, he began his career at GI Technology, where he played a key role in building India's first wallet infrastructure, iCash. In 2016, he founded iServeU to modernize banking infrastructure through cloud-native, microservices-based technology. Under his leadership, iServeU has built a robust payments platform processing over 3 million transactions daily and supporting 1,000+ TPS, with capabilities spanning UPI, card issuance, fraud management, and embedded lending. Sarangi has led the company in onboarding over 15 banks globally while advancing financial inclusion through secure, scalable banking solutions. A recognized thought leader, he has been a speaker at Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2025 and IAMAI India Digital Summit (IDS) 2026, and a panelist at Bharat Startup Summit (BSS) 2026.

name: Mr. Deep Agrawal
bio: A technologist at heart, Deep has passionately driven the adoption of digital platforms and products at population scale over the course of his 15 years’ experience across consumer technology, banking and payments. At PhonePe, he oversees the entire payments suite of offerings and has been instrumental in driving PhonePe’s foray into multiple business lines and products which are first of their kind. An early proponent of UPI, his expertise lies in identifying white space opportunities and creating innovative offerings utilising open platforms and by forging strategic partnerships. Prior to this, Deep was Executive Vice President, Digital Banking at YES Bank where he was responsible for setting up the emerging digital payments vertical. At YES Bank, he was also responsible for incubating and launching products such as YES Bank’s UPI and Aadhaar based payment solutions along with YES SIMsePAY with industry first solutions and partnerships resulting in market leadership for YES Bank in digital payments.

name: Mr. Deepak Mahaur
bio: Deepak Mahaur is Head – Digital Banking at ICICI Bank, where he leads the digital banking agenda with a focus on creating simple, intuitive, clutter-free and reliable digital experiences for customers. He brings over two decades of experience across financial services, digital transformation, technology, partnerships, customer experience and business leadership. Deepak has held diverse leadership roles across ICICI Bank and ICICI Lombard, spanning digital banking, real estate finance, insurance and strategic initiatives. His experience spans building customer-centric solutions, developing strategic partnerships, leading high-performing teams and managing complex business requirements. Prior to joining ICICI Bank, Deepak spent 17 years with ICICI Lombard, progressing through leadership roles and ultimately heading the Specialized Industries Group covering Aviation, Construction and Oil & Gas. He holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Management from IIM Lucknow and a B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering.

name: Mr. Deepak Mendiratta
bio: Deepak Mendiratta is the Chief Executive Officer of PayU Finance, the lending arm of PayU. Prior to this, he was the Chief Risk Officer at PayU India Credit. In his multifaceted role at PayU, Deepak has expertly navigated various responsibilities, including leading teams across risk management, policy, businesses and product, legal, and more. Deepak comes with over two decades of experience in banking and financial service industry spanning across lending, deposits, and payments. Prior to joining PaySense, which got acquired by PayU, Deepak served as the Head of Consumer Business and Product in Reliance Payment Solutions. He has also worked with Standard Chartered Bank and Capital One across multiple roles in product, data and marketing in unsecured lending businesses. Deepak holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Business Administration from NMIMS, Mumbai.

name: Mr. Deepak Shenoy
bio: Deepak Shenoy is the Founder of Capitalmind, the financial services group behind Capitalmind Wealth (PMS), Capitalmind Asset Management (Mutual Fund), and Capitalmind Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), with a combined managed AUM of over ₹5000 crore. Over the past decade, he has built Capitalmind from a widely followed markets and investing blog and an independent research platform into a research-driven diversified financial services business recognized for combining quantitative discipline with long-term investing principles. Among India's most influential voices on investing and financial markets, Deepak is known for making complex financial ideas accessible to investors. His insights on markets, economic policy, and wealth creation are widely followed, and his bestselling book, Money Wise, has become a trusted guide for long-term investors seeking a practical framework for building wealth.

name: Mr. Devraj Sanyal
jobTitle: Chief of AI, and Data Science Officer

name: Mr. Dilip Modi
bio: Dilip Modi is the Chairman of DiGiSPICE Technologies and Founder & CEO of Spice Money, driving financial inclusion across rural India through a million-strong network of Adhikari nanopreneurs. Beyond fintech, he scales enterprises through iExponential using disruptive technology and champions social innovation via Ek Soch. He also actively mentors startups like Shuttl and Uolo. Recognized as the youngest President of ASSOCHAM and Chairman of COAI, Modi’s achievements have earned him the Gujarat Chamber’s Youth Icon Award and the Social Entrepreneur of the Year honor at the ET Entrepreneur Awards 2025.

name: Mr. Dinesh Pai
bio: Dinesh heads investments for Zerodha/Rainmatter. He is also part of the Zerodha Founder's office.

name: Mr. Dipesh Karki
bio: Dipesh Karki is the Co-Founder & CTO of Vartis Platforms and LenDenClub where he leads technology and product development for one of India's largest peer-to-peer lending platforms. He oversees the platform's AI-powered credit assessment and machine learning models, driving innovation across the borrowing and lending experience. He has spearheaded a major push into AI and automation — the platform now runs over 20 AI and machine learning models supporting credit assessment, borrower-lender matching, and collections. Under his technology leadership, 95% of loan applications are now assessed within seconds using deep learning models, helping maintain one of the lowest NPA rates in the industry. His work spans LenDenClub's diversified model across P2P lending, Loan Service Provider (LSP), and Technology Service Provider (TSP) businesses. A graduate of NIT Kurukshetra in Electronics and Communication Engineering, he co-founded LenDenClub in 2015.

name: Mr. Dmytro Kolechko
bio: Dr. Dmytro Kolechko Chief Executive Officer, Wing Bank (Cambodia) Plc. Dr. Dmytro Kolechko is a seasoned financial expert with over 26 years of leadership experience across global markets including Ukraine, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Vietnam. He has a proven track record in market and operational risk management, revenue assurance, and credit management, driving initiatives that optimize risk frameworks, improve efficiency, and boost profitability. Recognized as a catalyst of change, Dmytro is known for anticipating market trends and shaping industry’s best practices. His expertise spans digital transformation, sustainable finance, and integrating advanced technology into banking operations, positioning him as a trusted advisor and forward-thinking leader in the global financial sector.

name: Mr. Dusmanta Kesari Patra
bio: Sh. Dusmanta Kesari Patra is a General Manager(Data analytics & strgatic innovation (DA & SI) division. Prior to this assignment,he has served as Deputy CISO. He holds certification in CISSP, CISA,CCNA,CISM,Arcsight SOC analyst etc. Mr. Patra is a hands-on expert in the implementation of advanced cybersecurity deployment. Under his strategic guidance,his team managed an extensive portfolio of 26 distinct cybersecurity components. By taking end-to-end responsibility for these systems,he has built a self-reliant unit that ensures a resilient security posture for the bank’s underlying IT infrastructure,significantly reducing cross-departmental dependencies. He also headed the implementation of NIST approved cipher suite which ensured Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) across public-facing websites of PNB. This implementation, ensure neutralizing 'Harvest Now, Decrypt Later' vulnerabilities and significantly hardening the organization's public infrastructure against future quantum threats.

name: Mr. Fred Bruggink
bio: Fred Bruggink is VP, Commercial at Tala and a member of its executive leadership team. Tala is a global financial infrastructure company delivering the world's most accessible financial services to the billions of people overlooked by legacy financial institutions. Fred leads Tala's commercial organization across both direct-to-consumer and partner channels, spanning portfolio performance, growth, and business development across Tala's markets. Before Tala, he spent nearly nine years at Boston Consulting Group, as a Partner in the Financial Institutions and Transformation practices, where he advised companies across the US, Latin America, and Asia, and incubated and scaled new ventures through BCG X. He holds a Bachelor of Arts, Cum Laude, in Economics from Harvard University.

name: Mr. Ganesh AR
bio: Mr. Ganesh AR is an Engineer and an alumnus of IIM, Calcutta. He comes with a cross-sectoral experience of over three decades handling large IT transformation initiatives across banking, capital markets and retail industries, wherein he held senior roles across various facets of IT and Information Security. Before joining JFSL in August 2023, he was the CISO at ICICI Bank for a period of five years, prior to which he led Corporate and Treasury IT at the bank for over seven years. In his earlier stint, he was part of the India leadership team at Tesco Shared Services Centre, Bengaluru and was involved in large-scale transition and capability building.

name: Mr. Gary Yang
bio: Gary Yang is the President of Asia-Pacific at Adyen, where he oversees the region's growth and operations. He previously served as Adyen’s Global Head of Account Management and Partnerships, driving merchant success, partnership ecosystem, and commercial growth globally. A seasoned operator, Gary’s career spans leadership roles at high-growth tech platforms, including VP of Operations at Peek and an early General Manager at viagogo, where he scaled international expansion and managed a full P&L. He also has broad experience across strategy consulting (BCG), product management (Microsoft), software engineering (Booz Allen Hamilton), and venture capital (GGV Capital). Gary holds an MBA from Stanford University Graduate School of Business, and a double degree in Computer Engineering and Finance from University of Maryland.

name: Mr. Gaurav Mathur
bio: Gaurav Mathur is the Founder and CEO of SafeGold. With more than $1+ bn in revenue, 75 million customers, SafeGold is Asia’s largest digital gold platform. SafeGold was ranked the 9th fastest growing company in Asia in 2024 by the Financial Times. It operates in multiple countries, including the UAE, Singapore, Thailand and India and has integrations with more than 100 banks, brokerage and tech firms across the region. Prior to starting SafeGold, Gaurav spent 15 years in the private equity industry as a co-founder of India Equity Partners where he helped raise and invest $650mn and as a Principal with JPMorgan in Singapore where he helped manage a $1bn portfolio. He has served as a Director on the boards of numerous companies including Manappuram Finance, Jubilant Foodworks, Quess Corp, Piramal Glass and MTR Foods. Gaurav started his career with Deutsche Bank in London. He has an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad and a BA in Economics from Delhi University.

name: Mr. Gaurav Sahgal
jobTitle: Managing Director & Country Head Global Network Banking (Multinational Corporate & Institutional Banking) - India
bio: Managing the Combined MNC clients of HSBC India within the Corporate and Institutional Banking Business.

name: Mr. Gautam Sinha
bio: Gautam Sinha is a dynamic and visionary leader with over two decades of experience in the financial services industry. As CEO of iFLOW, the technology business unit of Loantap, a leading digital lending platform in India, he has emerged as a thought leader in fintech. Gautam's expertise lies in driving value-driven digitization of business processes. Previously, he held pivotal roles at prominent organizations like Infosys, HCL, and Edgeverve/Infosys.

name: Mr. George Sam
bio: George Sam is Co-Founder & Business Head at Mindgate Solutions, bringing over 20 years of experience in the BFSI industry. Since co-founding Mindgate in 2008, he has grown it into a global payments powerhouse — processing approximately 1 in 5 real-time payments worldwide and over 50% of India's real-time transactions. He oversees business strategy, client engagement, and P&L across all verticals, leading a team of 1,200+ professionals across India, UAE, and Southeast Asia. A postgraduate of IIM Indore, George previously served as Business Head at Byzan System Pvt Ltd. Beyond his corporate role, he actively invests in incubator-stage startups. He envisions Mindgate becoming a leading global player in digital payments within the next three years.

name: Mr. Girish Budhiraja
bio: Mr. Girish Budhiraja is the Executive Vice President and Chief Sales and Marketing Officer at SBI Card. In his current role he strategically drives revenue growth and product innovation at SBI Card. Girish has a wealth of knowledge across Cards & payment industry while working with revered Global and Indian brands. He has a deep understanding of consumer behavior, emerging trends, digital payment platforms and unsecured lending. He holds a post-graduate diploma in management from the Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore, and bachelor’s degree in technology in mining engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad

name: Mr. Girish Pandey
bio: Director of Product Management at Meta responsible for Global Payment solutions across its messaging surfaces including WhatsApp. Strong track record of achievement and expertise in financial services sector including at Visa, Mastercard, Citi Group, Capital One and Deloitte.

name: Mr. Goverdhan Singh Rawat
org: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
bio: Shri Goverdhan S. Rawat assumed charge as Deputy Managing Director, NABARD on November 6, 2023. Previously, he served as Chief General Manager, Pune Regional Office. With around 30 years at NABARD, he has worked across project appraisal, infrastructure financing, rural development, credit planning, consulting, board functions, and HR. He joined NABARD in 1992 and has served in multiple states and at Head Office, Mumbai, including roles as faculty at BIRD and National Bank Staff College, Lucknow. He has held board positions in several institutions and currently serves as Chairman of NABSanrakshan Trustee Pvt Ltd and Director of NABVENTURES Ltd. He holds a degree in Agriculture & Animal Husbandry, CAIIB, a PG Diploma in Banking & Finance, and an MBA in Leadership & Strategy.

name: Mr. Guhan Muthuswamy
bio: Guhan Muthusamy is Co-Founder & Chief Architect at Mindgate Solutions, where he drives all product architecture and strategic technology decisions across business verticals. With over two decades of fintech experience, he has been instrumental in positioning Mindgate as a go-to partner for digital transactions — processing 2 in 5 real-time payments globally and over 50% of India's UPI transactions. Before co-founding Mindgate in 2008 alongside George Sam, he served as Software Architect at Byzan System Pvt Ltd, leading internet banking and payment gateway projects for international banks. A graduate of NIT Durgapur in Electronics & Communication, Guhan champions a collaborative, innovation-driven leadership style. He actively invests in fintech startups, believes strongly in the "Make in India for the World" philosophy, and pursues extreme adventure sports outside of work.

name: Mr. Guhaprasath Rajagopal
bio: Guhaprasath Rajagopal is a Managing Director and Head of Payments business in India for J.P. Morgan based in Mumbai. In this role, Guhaprasath is responsible for delivering market leading solutions to clients by leveraging J.P. Morgan’s unique global strengths coupled with local capabilities across Treasury Services and Trade Finance.​ Guhaprasath joined J.P. Morgan in 2010 and brings ~25 years of experience across Payments and Transaction banking spectrum. Throughout his career, Guhaprasath has held various leadership roles in Product management, Client origination, Service management and Technology. ​ Guha is passionate about technology and endeavors to digitize the Bank’s product suite. Under his stewardship, the Payments business in India has leapfrogged in client solutioning, fintech partnerships and digitalization. Guha is a known speaker in industry forums and panels. ​

name: Mr. Gunaseelan Sundar
bio: Gunaseelan Sundar — Business Strategist | Telecom & SaaS Veteran | CPaaS Market Maker With over 23 years in business development, Gunaseelan Sundar has built India's CPaaS ecosystem from the ground up, turning early ideas into one of the country's most respected brands in the space. An Electrical and Electronics Engineer with an MBA and a Master's in Psychology, he brings a rare blend of technical logic and human insight to business building — helping brands across BFSI, Retail, and New Economy sectors engage meaningfully across generations. A movie critic and avid traveller at heart, he believes great businesses are built by understanding people as much as products.

name: Mr. Hari Menon
jobTitle: Partner & EVP | Global Delivery & Business Head - AI, Wealth, & Capital Markets
bio: Hari Menon is a Partner and Executive Vice President at Intellect, where he heads the Wealth and Capital Markets business. With over two decades of technology and transformation experience in financial services, Hari has delivered some of the industry's most ambitious programmes — including one of the world's first fully agentic financial services solutions and one of the largest data migration and digital transformation initiatives in UK financial services history. He has created and delivered AI wealth solutions for customers globally, working with leading institutions such as St. James's Place, NBIM, Citigroup, HSBC, SBI, Kotak, Maybank, and Jio BlackRock. As Global Client Partner, Hari owns and manages Intellect's relationships with some of the world's largest wealth and asset managers, with deep expertise in AI, data strategy, ESG, and digital transformation. He also leads Intellect's dedicated joint venture developing and distributing an AI-first financial advisory platform for the UK market.

name: Mr. Harish Reddy
bio: Harish Reddy is Co-founder of Stable Money, a Bengaluru-based fixed-income investment platform that enables FD and bond investments. He is also CEO of Stable Broking Pvt Ltd, the OBPP arm of Stable Money. An IIT Bombay electrical engineering graduate, he spent more than a decade building automated trading systems across Indian and global markets, at Estee Advisors and Besseggen Infotech, before turning to retail fixed income. Stable Money, backed by leading investors including Nandan Nilekani's Fundamentum, Peak XV and Lightspeed, has over 6 million registered users and enables investments in fixed deposits across more than 16 banks, along with corporate and government bonds. It has facilitated over ₹13,000 crore of fixed-income investments in the last three years.

name: Mr. Harsh Vardhan Masta
bio: Harsh Vardhan Masta is a fintech leader with nearly two decades of experience in India’s digital payments ecosystem. As CEO of PB Pay and former Head of Digital Payments at PB Fintech, he has led regulatory, technology, and operational initiatives across payments, including securing PB Pay’s Payment Aggregator licence. He has also held leadership roles at IndiaMART Payments and contributed to industry initiatives through the Merchant Payment Alliance of India.

name: Mr. Harsh Vardhan Roongta
bio: Chartered Accountant | Heads a SEBI-Registered Investment Advisory firm | Personal Finance Expert • Founder of Fee Only Investment Advisers LLP, one of India's pioneering fee-only advisory firms. • Serial entrepreneur and business leader; past chair of the Association of Registered Investment Advisers (ARIA). • Member of SEBI's Investor Protection & Education Fund committee (IPEF). • Fortnightly column 'Truth Be Told' in Business Standard, focusing on Personal Finance and Life Planning. • Advocates that true financial planning empowers people to live with clarity, confidence, and meaning.

name: Mr. Harshil Mathur
bio: Razorpay is an omnichannel payments platform for businesses, strives to help Indian businesses with comprehensive and innovative solutions built with technology to address the payment and banking journey for any business. Established in 2014, the company strives to provide technology payment solutions to many businesses. Founded by alumni of IIT Roorkee, Shashank Kumar and Harshil Mathur, Razorpay is the second Indian company to be a part of Silicon Valley’s tech accelerator, Y Combinator. A few angel investors have also invested in Razorpay’s mission to simplify payments and business banking.

name: Mr. Hitendra Dave
bio: Hitendra Dave, formerly Head of Global Banking & Markets of HSBC India (known widely by his last name, Dave), has almost 30 years work experience in the Indian Financial Markets, of which the last 20 have been with HSBC. He joined the bank in 2001 in the Global Markets business and has risen through the ranks to his current role as MD & Head of Global Banking and Markets business, the dominant contributor to HSBC India’s PBT over the years.

name: Mr. Hitesh Sethia
jobTitle: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer
bio: Mr. Hitesh Kumar Sethia is the Managing Director and CEO of Jio Financial Services. A fellow member of the ICAI with an advanced management degree from Harvard Business School, he is a seasoned financial executive with over two decades of global experience across Europe, Asia, and North America. He spent the majority of his career at ICICI Bank Limited, holding leadership roles in credit, retail, corporate, and transaction banking. His expertise spans strategy, market development, compliance, risk management, and scaling operations. Notably, he was a key member of the setup team for ICICI Bank Canada, its first employee in Germany, and held country head positions in the UK and Hong Kong before serving as Head of Transaction Banking in Mumbai. He also serves on the boards of several entities, including Jio Credit, Jio Leasing, Jio Payments Bank, Jio Payment Solutions, Jio Insurance Broking, and Jio BlackRock Asset Management.

name: Mr. Hrushikesh Mehta
bio: Hrushikesh Mehta is Chief Business Officer – Financial Services at ONDC, where he is helping democratize access to financial services in India. Previously, he volunteered at iSPIRT and co-founded CredAll. Before that, he built all aspects of ClearScore's online credit and insurance marketplace business in India. Over a 25-year career — including nearly a decade at TransUnion CIBIL — Hrushikesh has held leadership positions across functions. He holds a degree in Business Administration from Bryant University (USA) and a postgraduate degree in Management from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad.

name: Mr. Indraneel Ajitkumar Pandit
bio: Indraneel Pandit serves as the Chief Digital Officer at Federal Bank, where he leads the institution’s digital transformation. With close to 25 years in banking, he has built a career defined by the intersection of high-stakes finance and human-centric technology. His professional journey spans premier foreign and Indian private sector banks. Before joining Federal Bank in 2019, he held leadership roles at Standard Chartered Bank, DBS Bank and Yes Bank across corporate banking and structured finance. At Federal Bank, he has been instrumental in scaling multi-billion dollar businesses and driving projects to modernize the bank’s franchise and position it as a future-ready, national powerhouse. He is a vocal advocate for Federal Bank’s motto "Digital at the Fore, Human at the Core” and strongly believes that technology should never be built for its own sake; it must always answer a real business question. He is an Engineer and an MBA and holds an FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certification.

name: Mr. Ishan Shah
bio: Ishan leads investment banking vertical at The Fintech Meetup, helping fintech founders tackle fundraise and M&A opportunities. He's been a former financial services journalist with Economic Times and Moneycontrol.

name: Mr. Ishan Sharma
jobTitle: Head of Sales and Business Development

name: Mr. Jason Chan
bio: Jason Chan leads government relations for Sumsub across APAC, where he builds strategic partnerships with regulators and industry associations to advance digital identity solutions. His multifaceted background provides valuable expertise in digital trust frameworks to his current role. He holds an MSc in Risk Management from Imperial College London and a BA in Economics from Cornell University. Jason is based in Singapore.

name: Mr. Jeremy Tan
bio: Jeremy Tan is the Founder and CEO of Liquid Group, a Singapore-headquartered cross-border digital payments non-bank financial institution (NFI). Liquid Group operates RoamQR, a multi-network payment platform that facilitates cross-border QR and real-time transactions between participating domestic payment schemes. Jeremy works at the intersection of industry and policy on regional payments connectivity. He is a member of Singapore’s Payments Council and serves as Co-Chair of the Payment Sub-Committee of the Singapore FinTech Association. He is the Singapore Representative to the East Asia Business Council (EABC), where Singapore co-chairs the Working Group on Digital Economy alongside Japan, and serves on the Malaysia-Singapore Business Council (MSBC).

name: Mr. Jitendra Gupta
bio: BFSI veteran with ~16 years of experience in the payments industry, best known as Founder of Jupiter, Citrus Pay and Lazy Pay. Jiten is the CEO and Founder of Jupiter, a digital-first bank designed to make money management simple for digitally savvy Indians. Before Jupiter, he served as MD at PayU India between Sep 2016 and June 2019. Prior to PayU, he founded Citrus Pay, which he scaled into a 300+ member team before selling to PayU in 2016, one of the largest fintech exits in India.

name: Mr. Joe Emmanuel
bio: Joe Emmanuel is a seasoned business leader with over two decades of experience in the global telecommunications and cloud communications industry. As a Global Market Manager at Proximus Global, he plays a key role in driving international growth, strategic partnerships and enterprise engagement across the CPaaS ecosystem. Throughout his career, Joe has held leadership positions across sales, business development and market expansion, helping organisations scale their global footprint and deliver innovative digital communication solutions. An alumnus of the Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, he is recognised for his expertise in enterprise communications, customer engagement and go-to-market strategy. Joe is passionate about enabling businesses to harness emerging technologies, including AI-powered communications, omnichannel engagement and network APIs, to create seamless and secure customer experiences worldwide.

name: Mr. K Balasubramanian
jobTitle: India Country Officer (ICO), India Subcontinent Sub-Cluster, and Banking Head
bio: He heads Citi’s overarching operations, corporate banking, and wholesale banking strategy across India, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka. A seasoned Citi veteran, Balasubramanian first joined Citi in 1996 as a Management Associate. Over the course of two decades, he held numerous roles across various functions including transaction banking, finance, and local corporate banking. Prior to becoming India Head, he served as the Asia South Head of Corporate Banking based in Singapore. He also had a brief stint outside of Citi, where he served as Head of Corporate Banking at HDFC Bank from May 2016 to late 2017. He holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree from Kolkata University (Calcutta). He is also a qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) and also holds an ICWA degree.

name: Mr. Kamal Budhabhatti
bio: Kamal Budhabhatti is the Founder & Head of Innovation and Founder of Little. A fintech entrepreneur and AI innovator, he has built digital platforms serving millions across Africa and Asia and is the author of My Mother Who Taught Me Business Without Knowing It.

name: Mr. Karthik Rajaram
jobTitle: General Manager and Country Head for India
bio: Karthik Rajaram is the General Manager and Country Head for India at ElevenLabs, an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. Karthik leads the company’s go-to-market strategy, revenue growth, and partner ecosystem in India. He brings over two decades of experience in scaling high-growth technology businesses, with leadership roles at Elastic, Freshworks, Akamai, and Microsoft. Prior to ElevenLabs, he served as GM & VP for India and South Asia at Elastic, where he drove enterprise adoption and built a strong partner ecosystem.

name: Mr. Kedar Kulkarni
bio: Kedar Kulkarni is the co-founder and CEO of HyperVerge, an AI-based company providing end-to-end customer onboarding solutions (KYC, Bank Statement Analysis, AML, Account Aggregator, etc) for industries like Banks, NBFCs, Fintech, Remittances, Securities & Brokerages, E-commerce, Logistics, EdTech. Kedar, a graduate of IIT Madras, from bringing together the founding team that has been working on computer vision since 2009, to leading the team and now becoming the industry leader in digital KYC with 2B+ digital KYCs, Kedar’s focus has always been to build a meaningful company - for the employees and for the partners. He has directed the company's growth to have over 500 + clients across multiple geographies. Away from work, Kedar lists Yoga and meditation as his number one priority. He believes strongly in contributing to people and society. During his leisure time, he also likes to mentor young entrepreneurs.

name: Mr. Kenneth Gay
bio: Kenneth Gay heads the FinTech and Innovation Group at MAS, driving tech and innovation strategies for Singapore’s financial sector. He previously led MAS’s Enterprise Knowledge Department, focusing on digital transformation, GenAI, and data governance. He also has experience in regulatory policy, financial stability, and reserves management. Kenneth holds a BA in Economics and MA in International Relations from the University of Chicago.

name: Mr. Ketan Doshi
bio: Ketan Doshi, MD of PayPoint, is a visionary FinTech leader powering last-mile digital finance. With a Master's in Financial Services Management, he fuses strategy and innovation to scale growth. Partnering with 100+ providers, he has empowered 1Cr+ customers with secure digital access. A changemaker and inclusion champion, he transforms challenges into opportunities, driving PayPoint's mission to bridge India's financial gap.

name: Mr. Ketan Merchant
bio: KETAN MERCHANT Interim CEO, Fino Payments Bank Ketan Merchant joined Fino Bank in 2018. His career prior to Fino spans across stints in HSBC, Standard Chartered and Barclays in India and overseas. Since the formative years of the Bank, he has been instrumental in building a sustainable model in a dynamic and changing banking landscape. Ketan with over 25 years of banking experience, besides spearheading Finance, Balance Sheet management and governance functions, is a pivotal pillar in formulation of strategy of the Bank. His main area of focus is accelerating growth-oriented strategies for the Bank and he has played a key role in listing the Bank in the year 2021. Under his stewardship the Bank has adopted three-pronged strategy of DDD (Data, Distribution and Digital) for Fino 2.0 vision and is gearing up for conversion into a differentiated Small Finance Bank.

name: Mr. Kris Gopalakrishnan
jobTitle: Chair, GFF2026, Founder - Infosys and Chairman

name: Mr. Krishna Bhyravajosyula
bio: Krishna Chaitanya is the Chief Product Officer at Perfios, where he spearheads the development of cutting-edge financial innovations that transform the BFSI industry. With a deep commitment to delivering seamless digital experiences, KC leads the expansion and evolution of Perfios’ product suite, driving sustained business growth and market leadership. With over 15 years of extensive experience in fintech, KC has a proven track record of building and scaling pioneering products across personal finance management (PFM), lending, insurance, and stock trading sectors. Before joining Perfios, he played a pivotal role at Paytm and Flipkart, where he led lending product strategies and engineered high-scale loan management, origination, collections, and risk management platforms. His work enabled rapid scaling of BNPL services through innovative alternate credit underwriting models.

name: Mr. Krishna Prasad Atluri
bio: A Krishna Prasad, is the Founder CEO of OneMoney, India's First and the Largest Account Aggregator. He is an Engineer MBA (XLRI), with 45 years of experience in Finance, Technology, Media (TV and Newspapers). He is passionate about using fintech products to serve the underserved and promoting Financial Inclusion.

name: Mr. Kshitij Jain
bio: COO of Blue Machines AI

name: Mr. Kunal Pande
jobTitle: Partner & National Head Cyber, Risk and Compliance
bio: Kunal is a Partner at KPMG and has over 27 years diverse experience with KPMG in advising clients across the globe. He has handled various leadership roles across Technology, Cyber Security and Risk Management with a focus on financial services Sector. He is currently National leader Cyber, Risk and Compliance Services at KPMG in India. He is also part of KPMG International Core Payments Team. Kunal has extensively worked with Regulators, Banks, Fintechs, Payment Cos, Brokers, Funds, MIIs, Insurance Cos, Telcos, IT services. He has authored reports, publication and articles and spoken in various symposiums or events across diverse topics like Digital Banking, Payments, Cyber Security, Data Governance and Privacy, Regulations Risk Management. He is Engineer (Gold Medalist) and MBA (IIM Mumbai).

name: Mr. Kunal Rana
