bio: Kunal leads the Merchant Partnerships for GPay across offline and online merchants. He is based out of Google’s Gurgaon office. Over the two decade long career, he has worked across leading Consumer and Tech companies including Apple, Flipkart, ITC, Coca Cola and BCG. He has led business P&L, BD and Strategy teams in the past. In his work as a strategy consultant he focused on Consumer consumers and Marketing and Sales functional topics, working with leading Indian and Global companies. Kunal is an MBA from IIM Bangalore.

name: Mr. Kush Mehra
jobTitle: President And Chief Business Officer - Payments Business

name: Mr. Ling Wu
bio: Ling Wu is the Founder & CEO of TBCASoft, Inc., a Silicon Valley-based leader in blockchain-powered cross-border payment networks and enterprise ecosystem solutions. Ling is driven by a vision to build the "AI-Era Financial Network" modeled on the foundational infrastructure of global telecom: a distributed infrastructure that preserves national sovereignty, unlocks global interoperability and insulates against geopolitical friction. In 2017, in collaboration with SoftBank, he launched the Carrier Blockchain Study Group (CBSG) to pioneer distributed ledger technology across global carriers. Building on this foundation, TBCASoft introduced HIVEX® in 2023 - a fully compliant, international mobile payment blockchain framework connecting the world's largest mobile wallet networks, national schemes and major traditional payment networks. Mr. Wu holds an M.S. in Scientific Computing and Computational Mathematics from Stanford University and a B.S. in Physics from National Taiwan University.

name: Mr. Madhu Menon V P
jobTitle: Managing Director, Global Head of SC PrismFX Sales
bio: Madhu Menon currently serves as Managing Director and Global Head of PrismFX Sales at Standard Chartered Bank, based in Singapore. With over 20 years of experience in financial markets, Madhu has held several leadership positions across the network, bringing deep expertise and a strategic perspective to every role. Madhu has been a valued part of Standard Chartered Bank since 2007 and now leads a global team of Payments FX sales professionals. Their team works closely with corporates and institutional clients, delivering best-in-class solutions for cross-border payments and collections linked FX. Madhu has played a pivotal role in expanding Standard Chartered’s fintech ecosystem distribution across several key footprint markets, helping drive innovation and growth. Madhu holds both an Engineering and Management degree from India,

name: Mr. Madhur Deora
bio: Madhur Deora is President and Group Chief Financial Officer at Paytm, India's leading digital payments and financial services company. He has been associated with Paytm since 2016 and is responsible for the company's long-term financial and commercial roadmap, investor relations, and corporate development. Prior to joining Paytm, Madhur spent over 17 years at Citigroup Investment Banking, where he was a Managing Director advising technology, media, telecommunications and private equity clients. He graduated cum laude from The Wharton School, and cum laude from The Phillips Exeter Academy.

name: Mr. Madhusudanan R
bio: Madhusudanan R. brings a rare combination of deep product acumen and a builder’s mindset. He is focused on transforming global banking with AI at its core, driven by the conviction that any business can embed financial services into its ecosystem. At M2P, this vision has translated into a trusted infrastructure that powers the future of financial services.

name: Mr. Mahesh Ramamoorthy
bio: Mahesh is the Chief Information Officer of YES BANK. In his role, he is leading Technology and Digital transformation for the Bank. Mahesh is also leading new age technologies such as API, AI/ML, BI and business solutions which is going to be driving factor for all new products at the Bank. Mahesh has over three decades of experience in the BFSI Leading technology capabilities as well as enabling change / managing the governance across the ecosystem. In his previous role, he was leading the Payments vertical for Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East and Africa at FIS Inc. Mahesh holds a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering with a specialization in Electronics from the University of Mumbai and is a certified Information systems Manager and a Marshall Goldsmith certified, Stakeholder centered Coach.

name: Mr. Maitreya Wagh
bio: Maitreya Wagh is the Founder & CEO of Bolna, where he is building voice-first AI infrastructure tailored for India’s multilingual, real-time enterprise environment. An IIT Delhi (2020) graduate, he began his career at Bain & Company, gaining exposure to scaling and operational complexity, before moving to Probo, where he worked closely with fast-growing consumer systems. Those experiences shaped his conviction that voice is India’s most natural interface and led him to build Bolna to make AI practical, reliable, and scalable in everyday business conversations.

name: Mr. Mangesh Surve
bio: Mangesh Surve has been in crucial leadership roles as the technology influenced the digital transformation of Industries and impacted daily lives of its consumers. He is currently leading the Red Hat Solutions Architect team for India and South Asia. He is consulting crucial verticals like BFSI, Telco, IT/ITES, Manufacturing, Defence, Government and Pharma on Cloud Native & Open Source based Digital transformation. He had also led the technology teams in Oracle during its transition to Cloud; He was leader of Information Management at IBM during that when Business has started looking at Analytics as one of the crucial pillars of their business.

name: Mr. Manish Kumar Gupta
jobTitle: Chief Executive of Urban Unsecured Assets, Payments, and Digital Partnerships
bio: Mr. Manish Kumar Gupta is the Chief Executive of Urban Unsecured Assets, Payments & Digital Partnerships at L&T Finance Ltd. (LTF). He is a senior leader with over 23 years of experience in financial and technology services domains and possesses a deep understanding of the retail and corporate banking landscape. His expertise extends to the rapidly evolving areas of digital banking, payments, and cards. Prior to LTF, he successfully scaled Glance Digital (InMobi Group) globally, innovating in AI-powered content and commerce experiences on smart devices. His impressive career includes leading major digital and business transformations at giants like ICICI Bank, Deutsche Bank, HSBC, DBS Bank, and TransUnion CIBIL. Mr. Gupta is an alumnus of Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) and holds an MBA from Indian School of Business, Hyderabad. He is also a Certified Financial Planner and CertICM holder.

name: Mr. Manish Sinha
bio: Manish has 31 years of experience in financial services. His career started in consulting, with McKinsey and Andersen. He then worked in consumer banking at Barclays and HSBC. He has been CEO at three different MNCs looking after India, Asia-Pacific and Middle East. These are Equifax, Dun & Bradstreet and Sterling Check. Since 2025, he is a Cofounder at Credilio and Fintech in credit cards. Manish is an alumnus of IIT Kanpur and IIM Calcutta, and lives in Mumbai.

name: Mr. Mannoj Varma
bio: Mr. Mannoj Varma is a seasoned Business Leader and Director at Lyra India, renowned for his strategic leadership in driving innovation and growth within the financial and technology sectors for more than 20+ years of experience. With a strong focus on taking Unified Payments Interface (UPI) to the global stage, Mr. Varma has successfully led initiatives in product and project management, facilitating the integration of cutting-edge digital payment solutions across diverse global markets. Mr. Varma has actively contributed to shaping policies in India related to payments, transportation technology, and railways, offering valuable insights to the Government of India. Additionally, he has provided policy inputs to the Government of Rajasthan to promote in-state business initiatives.

name: Mr. Manoj Dugar
jobTitle: Managing Director & Head Global Payments Solutions Asia, ex. Greater China
org: The Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited
bio: Manoj Dugar is Managing Director and Head of Global Payments Solutions, Asia ex. Greater China at HSBC. He leads HSBC’s payments franchise in Asia, delivering market-leading solutions to the to the bank’s corporate and institutional clients and driving business strategy through transformative technologies and fintech partnerships. With 28+ years of experience in Transaction Banking, Manoj has been driving thought leadership on Treasury and Payments through media engagements and events such as Money 20/20, Fintech forums in Asia and EuroFinance.

name: Mr. Manoj Kumar
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Mr. Manoj Kumar, as an Executive Director, is heading the Investment Management Department of SEBI. He has been associated with key SEBI initiatives such as Accounting Standards Committee chaired by Y H Malegam, Corporate Governance Committee chaired by Narayana Murthy. He has been the Member of the core group that successfully designed and implemented Integrated Market Surveillance System. Currently, he is a member secretary of the Mutual Funds Advisory Committee (MFAC).

name: Mr. Marco Massarenti
bio: Marco Massarenti has been with the European Central Bank (ECB) since 2010, bringing over 10 years of expertise in project and programme management across market operations, IT, and market infrastructure. He has developed strong management skills, overseeing complex initiatives that drive operational efficiency and innovation. Currently, Marco is responsible for programme management of TIPS (TARGET Instant Payment Settlement) interlinking initiatives. These initiatives aim to enhance the interoperability of instant payment systems, fostering seamless cross-border transactions and supporting the integration of financial markets. His work ensures the efficient coordination of technical developments, stakeholder collaboration, and strategic alignment to advance the ECB's vision for a unified payment landscape.

name: Mr. Mattia Musetti
bio: Mattia Musetti heads the North America and India desks at Luxembourg for Finance (LFF). Mattia’s role is to advise LFF and its stakeholders on the strategic orientation of the financial centre, specializing on a number of topics including fintech and private equity. He represents the Luxembourg financial industry abroad and helps others understand Luxembourg’s financial services and fund structuring toolbox and the industry in general. He advises international financial services companies, asset managers, FinTechs and multinational corporate groups to develop and scale up globally their cross-border financial operations through Luxembourg as the gateway to Europe. His geographic focus of attracting financial companies to Luxembourg is global, with specialties in North America, India, and EU Nordics.

name: Mr. Mayank Goyal
bio: Mayank Goyal, an esteemed financial professional with a substantial educational foundation from Imperial College London, boasts a decade of success in London's finance sector, notably in electronic trading and quantitative management at leading firms such as Merrill Lynch and Bank of America. As the Founder & CEO of HOP Financial Solutions, aka moneyHOP, he has led groundbreaking achievements in fintech, including facilitating over $400 million in remittances. Additionally, he is committed to educational philanthropy, significantly supporting the Pratham Education Foundation. His career highlights innovation, leadership, and a deep commitment to positive societal impact.

name: Mr. Metesh Bhati
bio: Metesh Bhati is the Chief Product & Technology Officer of Sahakar Sarathi Private Limited (SSPL), the NABARD and Ministry of Cooperation-backed shared services company building digital infrastructure for 385 Rural Cooperative Banks that together serve around 130 million customers across India. He leads product, technology and AI strategy for the cooperative banking ecosystem. He brings more than 20 years of experience building and scaling technology platforms at national scale across financial services, digital identity and digital public infrastructure, including ONDC, Aadhaar eKYC, Account Aggregator, UPI, etc. As EVP and Chief Digital & AI Officer at Protean eGov Technologies, he led digital and AI programmes spanning identity, financial services and citizen platforms. His current focus is trusted, sovereign and scalable AI for inclusive finance: agentic systems, AI trust infrastructure and DPI for the next billion users.

name: Mr. Michael Jennings
bio: Michael began his career at Banca d'Italia in 2007 as a member of the newly established TARGET2 team, contributing to the launch and operation of the Eurosystem’s RTGS platform. Building on this experience, he played a role in the functional design, testing, and implementation of TARGET2-Securities (T2S), the Eurosystem’s pioneering multi-currency securities settlement platform. He then joined the European Central Bank, where he held a dual position as a T2S Business Analyst and expert within the Vision 2020 programme. Upon returning to Banca d’Italia he became closely involved in the development and evolution of TARGET Instant Payment Settlement (TIPS) and the consolidation and modernization of the T2 and T2S infrastructures. Since 2025, he has served as Head of Development and Administration for Eurosystem Market Infrastructures, overseeing the strategic development of key payment and settlement services.

name: Mr. Mike Walters
bio: Mike was appointed CEO of Form3 in October 2023, having joined the organisation as CPO and co-founder in 2016. During his role as CPO he was responsible for strategy, product development, product management as well as strategic initiatives, playing a key role in the business’ funding activities and key client relationships. Prior to Form3, Mike held senior product roles within Barclays as Product Director for Barclaycard Payment Acceptance (card acquiring) and Head of UK Corporate Payments for Barclays Corporate Bank. Earlier in his career he managed client relationship teams responsible globally for the North American Financial Institutions and FTSE 250 sectors providing him with significant product and enterprise client experience domestically and internationally.

name: Mr. Mohit Monga
bio: Mohit is Vice President of Products, Financial Services leading the Insurance and Purchase Finance verticals at ONDC. Mohit has 15+ years of diverse experience across Product Management, P&L Management in diverse domains including Fintech and AI solutions for Insurance. Mohit has worked with organizations such as Pine Labs, Texas Instruments and Brillio where he built and scaled products in Payments, Lending, Insure tech and AI domains. Mohit is currently focused on creating country scale Digital Public Infrastructure for the Insurance industry.

name: Mr. Moiz Chohan
bio: Moiz Chohan is the Founder & CEO of PayRupy, a next-generation payments company focused on building secure, scalable, and intelligent payment infrastructure for businesses. With over 14 years of experience across banking, NBFCs, and fintech, Moiz has been instrumental in developing payment solutions that simplify digital transactions and support business growth. A passionate fintech entrepreneur, Moiz believes in building technology that solves real-world payment challenges through innovation, compliance, and reliability. His vision is to enable businesses with seamless payment experiences while contributing to the continued evolution of India's digital payments ecosystem.

name: Mr. Movin Jain
bio: Movin Jain is a fintech entrepreneur and Skydo’s Founder, working at the intersection of cross-border payments, regulation, compliance, AI and financial infrastructure. An IIT Delhi and IIM Ahmedabad alumnus, he has built systems across financial markets, payments, mobility, commerce and advertising at Barclays Investment Bank, InMobi, Ola, Meesho and PhonePe. At Skydo, Movin is focused on making cross-border payments faster, lower-cost and more transparent through zero FX markup, automated compliance and AI-led KYC workflows. Skydo serves 50,000+ Indian exporters, enables collections from 150+ countries, and has received final RBI PA-CB authorisation and licences in GIFT City and Canada.

name: Mr. Murali Mohan Rao Manduva
bio: Mr. Murali Mohan Rao Manduva has over 23 years of industry experience in Technology. He is a seasoned IT professional with experience in middle and senior management roles in IT services & Product Organizations like Polaris, Iflex (Oracle Financial Services) and Infosys. Prior to DCB Bank, Murali was with Infosys where he was designated as Head Delivery, India and Africa for Finacle, Infosys Banking product unit. As a technology professional he had led many large transformational projects in mid and large banks across different geographies including India. Murali has a Master's degree in Computer Applications from National Institute of Technology ( NIT), Trichy.

name: Mr. Muthu Krishnan
bio: A strategic planner and expertise in business creation and development, joined Gemini as Head of Business Development (BFSI), brings in over 29 years of experience in Payment domain spread across the card issuance and Acquiring framework. An accomplished expert in domain connected with all the major banks and fintechs in the BFSI segment. Recipient of numerous laurels in his career path

name: Mr. Nageen Kommu
bio: An IIM Ahmedabad and NITK alumnus, Nageen brings 20+ years of experience in telecom, consulting (EY), and startups. He drives product vision, growth, and platform strategy at Digitap, leveraging his deep expertise in AI/ML and digital transformation.

jobTitle: Senior Director, Government Relations, India and South Asia

name: Mr. Naveen Chaluvadi
bio: Naveen Chaluvadi is Chief Digital Officer at YES BANK, leading initiatives across digital channels and payments to position the bank as a preferred fintech partner. With over two decades in banking technology since 2003, he has expertise in product design, digital banking, and payments, with a passion for transaction engineering. A Mechanical Engineer from M. S. Ramaiah College and MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, Naveen is a recognized leader in driving digital transformation in financial services.

name: Mr. Naveen Kumar Kottala
bio: Naveen Kottala is a financial services leader with over 15 years of experience building and scaling lending businesses across gold loans, MSME finance, and digital lending. He has held leadership roles in leading fintechs and NBFCs, with expertise spanning strategy, risk management, distribution, operations, technology, and capital markets. As CEO of a listed gold loan NBFC, he has led rapid business growth while maintaining a strong focus on profitability, governance, and asset quality. An alumnus of IIM Lucknow and NIT Bhopal, Naveen is passionate about creating customer-centric financial institutions by combining technology, disciplined risk management, and operational excellence. He has extensive experience in scaling businesses, raising institutional confidence, and building high-performing teams to drive sustainable long-term growth.

name: Mr. Neeraj Matiyani
bio: Neeraj Matiyani, Head of India is a seasoned business professional working closely to improve customer experience across large banks in India and several tech companies. In his previous stint at AWS, he led initiatives to support and grow digital native businesses in India, focusing on leveraging cloud technology. Neeraj is known for his skills in Large opportunity management, business development, technology sales, marketing, media & analyst engagement, product and P&L management, people management & leading large sales teams, and contributing to the growth and success of the organizations he has been a part of

name: Mr. Neil Borate
bio: I head theFynprint, a digital publication and platform covering mutual funds, insurance, taxation, global investing and other personal finance subjects. I was formerly the personal finance editor at Mint. I am also co-author of the book, The Big Bull of Dalal Street, a biography of Rakesh Jhunjhunwala one of India's most successful investors.

name: Mr. Nick Soo
jobTitle: Managing Director, Asia Payment Product Head

name: Mr. Nikhil Aggarwal
bio: Nikhil is the Founder & CEO of Grip Invest, an investment platform dedicated to fixed-income products for retail investors. One of India's first Online Bond Platforms, Grip today enables over 4,000 Cr in investments annually. Nikhil started his career in banking with HSBC and then spent 6 years in Morgan Stanley's Investment Banking team. In 2016, Nikhil co-founded Chalo, India's #1 intra-city bus mobility application which today facilitates over 1 billion passenger rides annually. Nikhil also previously served as a Consultant to the World Bank on policy for public transportation and electric vehicles.

name: Mr. Nikhil Kurhe
bio: Nikhil is the CEO of Finarkein, where he drives the company’s product direction, long-term strategy, and positioning within India’s rapidly evolving open-data ecosystem. He works closely with banks, financial institutions, and ecosystem partners to enable secure, consent-driven data sharing while building scalable, future-ready solutions for the financial services industry. In parallel, Nikhil actively contributes to India’s open finance movement as a Volunteer Architect with Sahamati, the industry body overseeing the Account Aggregator framework. Through this role, he supports industry collaboration, ecosystem adoption, and the development of shared technical standards that underpin trust, interoperability, and scale across the financial data landscape.

name: Mr. Nilesh Lodaya
bio: Mr. Nilesh Lodaya currently serves as the Chief Business Officer and Head of New Projects at Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL). Prior to this appointment, he was Head of Direct Custody & Clearing, India at J.P. Morgan. He has extensive experience in financial services industry across various functions like business development, product management, operations, and controls.

name: Mr. Nitendra Rajput
jobTitle: Senior Vice President & Head, AI Garage

name: Mr. Nitesh Ranjan
bio: Shri Nitesh Ranjan is Executive Director of Union Bank of India. He is leading Bank’s digital transformation for delivering superior customer experience, enhancing employee engagement, and strengthening the balance sheet. While steering business outcomes, he emphasizes on continuous enhancement of risk and compliance standards. He is a member of the IBA Steering Committee on PSB Reforms. He has also served on the boards of NPCI, SUD Life Insurance Company, SWIFT India, SBI Global Factors Ltd, and FIMMDA, and was a founding member of the India Forex Committee (IFXC). Shri Ranjan holds a postgraduate degree in Economics and has also completed the Leadership Development Programme of IIM Bangalore.

name: Mr. Nitin Bhatnagar
jobTitle: Regional Director - India, South Asia and Middle East

name: Mr. Nitin Chugh
bio: Nitin Chugh is an accomplished BFSI leader with an overall experience of nearly 33 years. Before joining Perfios as its Group CEO and MD, he served as Deputy MD and Head of Digital Banking & Transformation at SBI from March 2022 to March 2026. In his earlier roles, he headed Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd as its MD and CEO from Dec 2019 to Sept 2021. He also served for over 18 years at HDFC Bank from 2001 to mid-2019, where he managed several leadership roles in retail banking. His last role at HDFC Bank was that of Group Head for Digital Banking where he oversaw the digital transformation of HDFC Bank from 2013 to 2019. In the earlier years of his career, he worked in different sales and relationship roles at Standard Chartered Bank, Modi Xerox Ltd and HCL Ltd. Nitin is one of those rare leaders who combines a deep understanding of technology and domain. He has led and managed impactful large scale digital and technology led business transformation over the last decade and a half.

name: Mr. Pankaj Dinesh Gadgil
bio: Pankaj Gadgil is the MD & CEO of Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited and Head of Digital Platforms & Payments Strategy at Aditya Birla Capital. A seasoned leader with over 25 years of experience, he is driving the company’s evolution into a digitally enabled, customer-first financial powerhouse. Since joining the Aditya Birla Group in 2022, he has accelerated growth in the housing finance business while leading the development of ABCD—an integrated omnichannel platform offering a comprehensive suite of financial and payment solutions. Prior to this, Pankaj spent 19 years at ICICI Bank, where he led diverse portfolios across retail banking, SMEs, and payments, and spearheaded several industry-first digital innovations including InstaBIZ, API Banking, Trade Online, and Eazypay—many of which earned global recognition. He has also served as a nominee director on the boards of NPCI, NPCI International, ICICI Merchant Services, and ICICI Securities.

name: Mr. Pankaj Mishra
bio: Pankaj Mishra is working in UTI AMC as Head -Digital & Fintech and is driving strategic Digital & Fintech Agenda across UTI AMC, covering Growing Digital Assets, Driving Business, Data and AI initiatives. He is having 18+ years of cross-functional experience in Banking and Asset Management space with proven track record in driving Digital Business, Implementing Large projects and managing customer life cycle at State Bank of India, HDFC Bank & UTI AMC.

name: Mr. Pankaj Singh
bio: Pankaj Singh has been an ex-banker having worked across Bank of America, American Express, ICICI Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank. Pankaj has been co-founder at Yatra Angel Network and Aagama Ventures, a fintech focused only fund.

name: Mr. Parthasarathi Patnaik
bio: Partha is a seasoned banker with nearly 30 years of experience across RBS, ABN AMRO Bank, Crisil, and Tata Steel. Partha has had the unique perspective of heading risk management in his early professional years before leading teams to build profitable businesses in corporate and investment banking and, more recently, in setting up a VC fund in India. Partha is an engineer from IIT, an MBA from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies, and an alumnus of Wharton Business School. As Chief Risk Officer, Partha is currently spearheading efforts at setting up a data-driven credit underwriting business at Vayana.

name: Mr. Paul Stamas
jobTitle: Managing Director, Global Head of Financial Services
bio: Paul Stamas is a Managing Director and Global Co-Head of General Atlantic’s Financial Services sector.

name: Mr. Paul van Sint Fiet
jobTitle: Managing Director, Head of Cross-Currency Solutions, APAC

name: Mr. Phoram Mehta
jobTitle: VP & Head of International Cyber Risk
bio: Phoram Mehta is the VP & Head of International Cyber Risk at PayPal. A seasoned professional with 25 years of experience and technical leader with over two decades in Information Security, Mr. Mehta has been instrumental in building secure technology solutions for multiple companies across a spectrum of sectors including financial services, healthcare, telecommunication, and government globally. He currently serves as Co-Chair on the AmCham Singapore Cybersecurity Cmte, has been on the board of Cyber Risk Institute, ISACA Singapore chapter President and advises cybersecurity startups in Singapore, India and US. Mr. Mehta has a Bachelors and Masters in Computer Science with specialization in Cybersecurity.

name: Mr. Pietro Tiberi
bio: Pietro Tiberi is a manager at the Bank of Italy's Information Technology directorate general where he has worked since 2013 in the Operations directorate. He is the head of the technical support and infrastructure Division for the payment systems (Target2, Target2 Securities and TIPS) that the Bank of Italy manages on behalf of the Eurosystem. He previously worked as an engineer at the WIND telecommunications developing monitoring and support systems for mobile and fixed networks. Pietro has master degrees in electrical engineering and space physics and has authored scientific publications in the area of space physics, carbon footprint and quantum security in payment sys-tems.”

name: Mr. Prakash Sikaria
bio: Prakash Sikaria is the Founder and CEO of super.money, a next-gen money app that’s redefining how India spends money, builds wealth and accesses credit. Launched in mid-2024 and backed by Flipkart, super.money has already become India’s fifth-largest UPI app, and recognised as India’s Fastest Growing Payments App at the Sensor Tower APAC Awards 2025. Under Prakash’s leadership, the brand is pioneering India’s credit-first digital money ecosystem; blending payments, savings, and secured credit into one seamless app experience.

name: Mr. Pramod Rao
bio: Mr. Pramod Rao is the Former Executive Director of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and a distinguished legal and regulatory expert with over three decades of experience across financial services, capital markets, banking, and corporate governance. During his tenure at SEBI, he led key functions including Debt and Hybrid Securities and the Enquiry & Adjudication Department, contributing significantly to the evolution of India's securities market regulatory framework. Prior to SEBI, he served as Group General Counsel at ICICI Bank, General Counsel for Citi India, and Partner at IndusLaw. An alumnus of the National Law School of India University (NLSIU), Bengaluru, Mr. Rao is widely recognized for his expertise in financial regulation, fintech, governance, and policy, and is a respected voice on the future of India's financial ecosystem.

name: Mr. Pranav Chawda
org: JP Morgan Chase Bank India N.A.
bio: Pranav Chawda is the CEO of JPMorgan Chase Bank, India, and Head of Global Corporate Banking. Appointed to this role in 2024, he leads the firm’s India bank franchise, driving strategic growth across corporate and Institutional banking. Under his leadership, JPMorgan India branch, serves a diverse client base, including top-tier Indian corporates, multinational companies, financial institutions and global investors.

name: Mr. Pranav Mishra
jobTitle: President & Consumer Banking Head - Distribution & Transformation

name: Mr. Pranay Bipin Jhaveri
bio: Mr. Pranay Jhaveri has been with Euronet for 10 years & has held various sales leadership positions with fortune 50 multinationals prior to Euronet. He has rich experience in digital payments, enterprise sales & business development, partnerships and apt at strategic planning and execution. Under his leadership Euronet India businesses, associated revenues and operating income has grown multi-fold making Euronet one of the largest B2B payment enterprise in India.

name: Mr. Pratekk Agarwaal
bio: Pratekk Agarwaal Founder & General Partner, GrowthCap Ventures Pratekk Agarwaal is a seasoned entrepreneur and early-stage venture capitalist with over two decades of leadership experience across fintech, financial services, and venture investing. He is the Founder & General Partner at GrowthCap Ventures, an operator-led early-stage VC fund focused on fintech, AI and Deeptech startups. Before launching GrowthCap, Pratekk held leadership roles at Bajaj Finance, Fullerton, IndoStar Capital, and BharatPe. Before launching the Institutional Fund, he personally backed over 30 startups who then raised future rounds from large VCs . Pratekk also serves on advisory boards of portfolio companies and was part of the G20 Startup20 Corporate Governance Committee. He is also a Trustee Board Member at TiE Mumbai & Council Committee Member with IVCA – Emerging Managers Council .

name: Mr. Pratip Banerji
bio: Pratip Banerji leads the Fiserv client franchise in India and across South Asia, driving growth and advancing the delivery of innovative banking, financial solutions and payments solutions to financial institutions and fintech players. Bringing more than 35 years of leadership experience across banking, payments and technology, Pratip leads Fiserv’s Financial Solutions business in India and Sri Lanka, where the company is a market leader in issuer processing. Under his leadership, Fiserv supports nine of the top twelve banks in India with a unified, enterprise account-processing platform spanning payment cards, loans, prepaid products, and commercial card solutions.

name: Mr. Praveen Regmi
bio: Praveen Regmi is the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of IME Khalti Limited, (part of IME Group Nepal) the entity formed by the historic merger of Nepal’s two leading digital wallets, IME Pay and Khalti. With over 21 years of experience across fintech, banking, and telecommunications, he has been a pivotal figure in modernizing Nepal’s digital payment ecosystem. Before taking the helm at the merged entity, he served as the CEO IME Digital Solutions (IME Pay) and previously held leadership role at Various Banks in Nepal. A graduate in Engineering with an MBA, he is also the Founding President of the Payment Service Providers (PSP) Association of Nepal, where he has been instrumental in driving policy reform and industry collaboration.

name: Mr. Pravin Jadhav
bio: Pravin Jadhav is founder of Raise Financial Services. Raise is building a new-age financial services company anchored around capital markets with focus on product, technology and customer service. It owns and operates consumer finance platforms like Dhan, Millions, Fuzz AI, Upsurge, Stratzy, Pluto and FilterCoffee.

name: Mr. Priyam Bose
jobTitle: Global Head GTM, Truecaller for Business
bio: Priyam leads the global GTM(Go To Market) mandate for Truecaller for Business. As part of the mandate, he and his teams focus on driving discoverability, adoption, and monetization of Truecaller for Business's suite of products across enterprises globally. Priyam has 24+ years of leadership experience across mobile, enterprises, start-ups, and developer-focused business ecosystem building from scratch to scale across India, APAC, Europe, MENA & North America. Before Truecaller, Priyam led mobile and cloud product business partnerships with digital natives and the developer ecosystem at Microsoft in India. His stint at Nokia helped create and scale the first-ever app store-led mobile app developer business in India and South Asia. He also has years of experience working with Asian/Indian start-ups, digital brands, and global technology platforms/brands to help them scale in emerging and growth markets, from product development to go-to-market lifecycle.

name: Mr. Rahul Ayyappan
bio: I am the Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer of Finacus Solutions, where I lead the vision and development of the banking and payment technology platforms. Over the last decades, I have worked closely with banks, financial institutions, and payment ecosystem partners to build scalable and secure digital payment infrastructures across IMPS, UPI, wallets, merchant payments, and transaction switching systems. My focus is to empower banks and financial institutions with robust, scalable, and secure technology that enhances customer experience and drives growth. My vision is to transform financial services through seamless technology integration, making banking accessible, efficient, and inclusive.

name: Mr. Rahul Chari
bio: Rahul is the Founder and CTO of PhonePe, one of India’s largest fintech companies. A serial entrepreneur with over two decades of experience in consumer internet and enterprise software, he specializes in building web-scale platforms tailored for hyper-growth. Prior to PhonePe, he was the VP of Engineering at Flipkart, where he spearheaded the supply chain technology division after joining via the 2011 acquisition of Mallers Inc. He co-founded Mallers Inc. in 2009, serving as CTO and creating the MIME360 digital distribution platform. Earlier in his career, he developed market-changing SAN switches and storage solutions at Cisco Systems, entering via the Andiamo Systems acquisition, and earned multiple storage virtualization patents. Rahul holds an MS in Computer Science from Purdue University and a BS in Computer Engineering from Mumbai University, where he was a Gold Medallist.

name: Mr. Rahul Dilipkumar Choube
jobTitle: Head of Value Added Services, India and South Asia
bio: Rahul Choube heads Visa's Value-Added Services (VAS) and Urban Mobility for Visa India and South Asia, overseeing a portfolio spanning acceptance, risk, identity, cybersecurity, loyalty, and issuing solutions. He partners with banks, fintechs, merchants, and public-sector stakeholders to accelerate digital commerce, enhance customer experiences, and drive greater trust and security in the payments ecosystem. Rahul also leads the urban mobility charter for Visa engaging with government, banks and other industry stakeholders. Rahul brings over 20 years of leadership experience in payments and financial technology, with a focus on scaling businesses, building strategic partnerships, and driving innovation across emerging markets.

name: Mr. Rahul Jain
bio: Rahul is the CEO and Co-founder of Peach Payments, a fast-growing African payment solution provider (PSP) that makes online commerce and digital payment acceptance easier and more accessible across Kenya, Mauritius and South Africa. He has worked with leading e-commerce websites and apps across Africa to improve their conversion rates, mitigate risk and optimise customer experience. He has participated in accelerators sponsored by Google and Barclays Africa as well as spoken at numerous events including Youth Pravasi Bhartiya Divas, Africa FinTech Festival, ECOM Africa, and Seamless Africa. He was named IESE Business School’s 40Under40 Entrepreneur of the Year in 2022, the school from which he earned his M.B.A. Previously, Rahul worked with a strategy consulting firm in Boston, USA where he advised large retailers and airlines regarding e-commerce, marketing and ancillary revenue streams.

name: Mr. Raj Kasi
bio: Raj is the General Manager of Hello Clever, an Asian payments infrastructure company enabling global businesses to accept and route payments across rails including PayNow, PromptPay, PayID, DuitNow, GCash, QRIS, and MoMo. Raj specializes in cross-border payments and interoperability, with deep expertise across emerging markets in Asia, Africa and Latam.

name: Mr. Rajeev Ranka
bio: Rajeev began his professional career as a Business Analyst in the BFSI sector at Deloitte Consulting & Strategy, where he assisted Bandhan Microfinance in developing the roadmap for its transition into banking. He subsequently worked with Lazada, a Southeast Asia-based Rocket Internet portfolio company later acquired by Alibaba. At Incubate Fund Asia, Rajeev oversees India investment activities for both the early-stage fund and the SMBC Asia Rising Fund. His portfolio includes: Captain Fresh, Easy Home Finance, Shivalik Small Finance Bank, M2P, Flipspaces, Vayana, Drip Capital, Glamzy, AEREM Solar, Olvy, and DPD Zero.

name: Mr. Rajesh Jha
bio: Mr. Rakesh Jha is an Executive Director on the Board of ICICI Bank Limited. He is responsible for the retail, small enterprises and corporate banking businesses of the Bank. He is the Chairperson of the Board of ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited, ICICI Home Finance Company Limited and ICICI Securities Limited. He has been with ICICI since 1996 and has worked in various areas. He was the Group Chief Financial Officer in his previous role. He has a management degree from the Indian Institute of Management, Lucknow and an engineering degree from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi.

name: Mr. Rajesh Pai Fondekar
jobTitle: Group Vice President & Head of Product Management, Digital Financial Solutions
bio: With over 25 years of experience in Payments, digital channels and Transaction Banking, Rajesh has a proven track record of successfully managing digital business and driving transformation. He holds a deep understanding of the electronic payments and channels in Retail as well as corporate banking. His expertise span across various domains, including retail banking, corporate banking, transaction banking and trade finance. He is passionate about delivering exceptional digital experiences to customers and driving business growth through innovative solutions. Rajesh possesses strong leadership and interpersonal skills, enabling him to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive successful project outcomes.

name: Mr. Rajesh Saxena
bio: Rajesh Saxena is the Chief Executive Officer of Consumer Banking at Intellect Design Arena Limited, leading strategy, innovation, and growth for the company’s global retail banking business. He has over 30 years of experience in retail banking, with expertise in distribution, digital banking, branch operations, credit cards, personal loans, and other unsecured lending. Rajesh has managed large Product and Geography P&L portfolios for more than 15 years, delivering sustained growth and profitability. Previously, he was CEO of American Express India, responsible for the credit card business, and spent 19 years with Citibank across multiple geographies in senior product and country P&L roles. He has extensive experience in scaling new businesses and deep insight into retail customer behaviour. Rajesh holds an MBA in Marketing & Finance from XLRI and a Gold Medal in Mechanical Engineering from BITS Pilani.

name: Mr. Rajesh Thapar
bio: Rajesh is CISO at NSE India Ltd and has over 3 decades of IT and Infosec experience primarily in BFSI. Prior to NSE, he was CISO of Axis Bank Ltd and Yes Bank Ltd. He specialises in cyber risk assessments, designing and driving enterprise security programs, driving control optimization initiatives and balancing adoption of emerging technologies with appropriate risk management.

name: Mr. Rajith Shaji
bio: Rajith Shaji is Co-founder & CEO at Volopay. He previously held product and growth roles across leading fintech platforms, including MatchMove (one of Southeast Asia’s largest card-issuance companies), BankBazaar (one of India’s largest financial marketplaces, backed by Amazon), and MoneyHero Group (NASDAQ: MNY), a public personal finance and comparison platform in Hong Kong. Rajith brings deep payments experience and a strong understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements, having led card-issuance programs across major APAC markets.

name: Mr. Rajiv Naresh
bio: Rajiv Naresh is the Managing Director and CEO of Navi Limited (formerly Navi Technologies Limited) and a founding team member of the Navi Group. Since joining Navi in early 2019, he has held multiple roles across the organisation - from setting up the Legal, Secretarial, and Compliance functions, to being Chief of Staff to the Founder, Mr. Sachin Bansal, to serving as CEO of Navi Mutual Fund. He also has held multiple Board positions in executive and non-executive capacities across the Navi Group. A trained lawyer qualified to practice in India, Rajiv began his career as a transactional lawyer at a Bangalore-based corporate law firm where he represented market-leading clients in multimillion-dollar deals across the TMT, renewable energy, and security services sectors, and worked closely with leading startups in health tech, fintech, e-commerce, and ed-tech.

name: Mr. Rakesh Kashyap
org: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development

name: Mr. Rakesh Purohit
jobTitle: Global Product Head of Cross Currency Payments & Solutions
bio: Rakesh Purohit is the Global Product Head of Cross Currency Payments & Solutions at J.P. Morgan. In this role, his responsibilities include product management and commercialization of solutions in cross currency payments for Corporate and Financial Institutions, in partnership with Payments and Markets sales teams. Rakesh has more than 20 years of experience managing Product and Sales teams in multiple regions in FX and Cross Border Payments having worked in Asia, Latin America, and North America. Over the years he has built a wealth of expertise in FX Strategy, Partnership Development and Delivery of transformative solutions for clients globally.

name: Mr. Rama Mohan Rao Amara
bio: Mr. Rama Mohan Rao Amara took over as the Managing Director (Retail Business & Operations), State Bank of India on 1st December 2025. As a MD (RB&O), he oversees retail banking business of SBI, which serves more than 530 million customers in India’s largest bank. Prior to this Mr. Amara was MD responsible for International Banking, Global Markets and Technology wings in SBI. He also worked as Group Chief Risk Officer in the bank, where he strived to strengthen the enterprise-wide risk management framework. As MD & CEO of SBI Card, a pureplay credit card company, for two and a half years, he steered the company successfully and improved its market position. He amassed international experience while handling key assignments in Singapore and the US. An engineering graduate, Mr. Amara also holds recognized financial credentials – CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) and FRM (Financial Risk Manager).

name: Mr. Ramakrishnan Gopalan
jobTitle: Head of Products & Solutions, India and South Asia
bio: Ramakrishnan Gopalan is the Head of Products & Solutions for India and South Asia at Visa. He leads product strategy and long-term design for Visa’s portfolio across India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, and Maldives, driving growth and innovation in the region. Prior to Visa, Ramakrishnan (Ramki) spent nearly 20 years with Citi across India and Singapore in senior roles spanning cards, lending, client engagement, risk management, product development, and digital channels. He also served as Director of Strategic Initiatives for Citi’s Regional Cards and Loans business, where he led digital acquisition strategies using alternate data across markets.

name: Mr. Ramanathan RV
bio: A passionate engineer-turned-entrepreneur and a foundational figure in India’s payments revolution, Ramanathan has spent his career in building deep technology solutions, including India’s first UPI app, BHIM. As co-founder and CTO at Juspay, he built the company into a payments leader, currently valued at 1.2 billion dollars. Now, as the co-founder and CEO of Hyperface, he's on a mission to reimagine the very foundation of card technology, helping banks build digital-first programs that deliver elevated customer experiences and drive real business impact.

name: Mr. Ranjan R Reddy
bio: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yH39pze20HEOTktQOw-9-xFTHbYxahjWJjUJYnzDyy4/edit?usp=sharing

name: Mr. Ranvir Singh
jobTitle: Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
bio: Ranvir Singh is the Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Kissht, one of India’s leading technology-led digital lending platforms. With over 20 years of experience in financial services and consulting, he has led Kissht’s growth into a trusted lending platform offering personal loans and loans against property across India. Under his leadership, Kissht has leveraged technology, data-driven underwriting and digital innovation to make credit faster, simpler and more inclusive, while maintaining a strong focus on responsible lending, risk management and regulatory compliance. Before founding Kissht, Ranvir was with McKinsey & Company, advising leading banks and financial institutions across India and Southeast Asia. He is also a founding member of the Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment (FACE). Ranvir holds a B.Tech. from IIT Bombay and a PGDM from IIM Bangalore.

name: Mr. Raoul Nanavati
bio: Raoul Nanavati leads Navana.ai, where the focus is on driving high-value business outcomes for the BFSI industry with Voice AI. Navana moves beyond generic tools to provide the Bodhi Voice AI Contact Centre, a specialized solution engineered for high-volume automated calling in India. Powered by robust Bodhi Voice AI models, Navana supports 15 Indian languages, allowing financial institutions to operate with the empathy and accuracy required for regional communication at scale. Navana’s technology is purpose-built to handle the nuances of the Indian market, enabling banks and insurers to automate critical workflows, from driving loan sales and origination to managing debt collections, regulatory compliance, and customer service. Raoul complements this commercial focus with a commitment to R&D and ecosystem development, collaborating with IISc Bangalore, IIT Madras, and Microsoft Research to build the datasets and infrastructure that power the next generation of Indian voice AI.

name: Mr. Ravi Modani
bio: Dr. Ravi Modani is Founder, MD & CEO of 121 Finance, an RBI-registered NBFC-Factor and India's largest lender on GeM Sahay. He holds a Ph.D. in Working Capital Management and brings over three decades of entrepreneurial experience, building a customer network spanning 32 countries. A Director on the Board of the Factors Association of India and Immediate Past President of TiE Rajasthan — recognized as Global Best Chapter during his tenure — he has also volunteered with iSPIRT on the OCEN framework, helping expand MSME access to finance. His article on India's factoring evolution was published by the International Factoring Association.

name: Mr. Ravi Pangal
bio: Mr. Ravi Pangal is the Chief Information Officer at IndusInd Bank. He brings over 30 years of experience in Finance IT, having led large technology organisations across global banking institutions. His expertise spans retail and core banking platforms, enterprise integrations, and large-scale digital transformation programmes. Most recently, he served as Global CIO – Retail Products and Core Banking. He has previously held leadership roles at HSBC, Wipro, Reuters, ANZ Bank and Standard Chartered. Ravi holds a master's degree in computer applications and a bachelor's degree in mathematics and Statistics from Bharathiar University.

name: Mr. Ravinder Singh
bio: An alumni of IIM Kozhikode, Mr. Ravinder Singh, a Graduate in Arts with CAIIB – I, has completed a one-year Advanced Management Program from IIM Kozhikode. Mr. Singh has also completed one-year Chief Executive Officer program from IIM Lucknow. Mr. Ravinder Singh commands over three decades of experience across the banking sector, with long stints in Branch Banking, Retail, Large, Mid-Market, SME & Micro segment lending and Risk departments. Two-thirds of his working experience was with State Bank of India and Axis Bank, with each stint accounting for a decade. Besides, he has also worked with marquee Banks including Dena Bank and State Bank of Patiala. Mr. Singh joined SVC Bank in August 2016 and was Chief General Manager handling Corporate Banking prior to being assigned the interim MD.

name: Mr. Reeju Datta
bio: Reeju Datta is the co-founder of Cashfree Payments, India’s leading AI-native payments company. Reeju's leadership at Cashfree Payments centers around excellence in brand, marketing, growth & strategy, finance, hiring and customer experience; all while fostering a technology-first culture. Beyond the day-to-day operations, Reeju also acts as a brand architect steering the company to become the preferred choice for merchants.

name: Mr. Reuben Lim
bio: Reuben is Managing Director at Mars Growth Capital, driving investments in the region. He brings two decades of cross-sector leadership experience in management, business development, strategy, and go-to-market execution across industries including aviation, real estate investment, marine, intellectual property, and fintech. He holds a Business Management degree (Magna Cum Laude) from SMU and a Graduate Diploma in IP & Innovation Management from SUSS.

name: Mr. Richard Nash
jobTitle: Vice President, Head of Global Government Relations

name: Mr. Ripunjai Gaur
bio: With a distinguished career spanning over 19 years, Ripunjai Gaur serves as the Chief Operating Officer for Offline Payments at Paytm Payments Services Ltd. He leads the largest offline payments platform in India, serving over 40 million merchants across various sectors and geographies. Ripunjai has been instrumental in expanding Paytm's offline merchant business from the ground up, spearheading various teams such as Sound Box, EDC, and cash voucher business, significantly increasing the user base. His expertise includes designing and developing full-stack payments and financial solutions for the merchant business, managing the P&L, enhancing operational efficiency, fostering partnerships, and optimizing the merchant lifecycle for cross-selling opportunities. A financial services veteran, Ripunjai is deeply passionate about financial inclusion and firmly believes that digital payments will transform the way people live and work.

name: Mr. Rishabh Raja
bio: Rishabh Raja is the Director & CEO of Sayyam Investments Private Limited, an RBI-registered NBFC. With over a decade of leadership experience across NBFCs, fintech, wealthtech, and technology, he is focused on driving digital transformation, responsible lending, and financial inclusion. At Sayyam, he leads the company’s journey toward building a scalable, technology-driven financial ecosystem, with a strong focus on innovation, customer experience, and sustainable growth.

name: Mr. Rishi Kapoor
jobTitle: Executive Director, Head of Technology & Operations
org: Asia Securities Industry & Financial Markets Association

name: Mr. Ritesh Pai
jobTitle: CEO and Executive Director, International Payments
bio: Ritesh Pai is the Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director, International Payments at PhonePe, where he leads the company’s global payments strategy and expansion. With over 29 years of experience, he has built and scaled digital platforms across domestic and international markets, with deep expertise in digital transformation, product development, and omni-channel commerce. He is responsible for driving international market expansion, developing localized payment solutions, and building strategic partnerships, while ensuring strong customer experience and business growth. Prior to this, he has transformed underperforming digital channels into large-scale platforms serving millions of customers. Ritesh holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce and a Master’s Degree in Financial Management Studies (Finance).

name: Mr. Roelant Prins
bio: As the Chief Commercial Officer of Adyen, Roelant is responsible for all commercial activities and development. After starting his career as a consultant, he moved on to the online payments industry in early 2000. Throughout the years, Roelant has held various international management roles in sales and business development for companies providing payment solutions to international ecommerce businesses. He has earned a degree in Economics from Erasmus University Rotterdam. Roelant is a member of the Supervisory Board of Seenons B.V.

name: Mr. Rohan Bagai
bio: With over 19 years of experience, Rohan Bagai is part of the Firm’s Technology, FinTech & Data Protection practice. Rohan has a wide range of technology and financial services experience with a special focus on Payments, Virtual Digital Assets and Privacy & Data Protection. He regularly advises clients on legal, regulatory and compliance issues relating to the launch of digital, e-commerce, virtual digital asset and payment businesses, including the operations of payment systems and introduction of new age electronic payment methods. Rohan holds an LLM from New York University.

name: Mr. Rohit Arora
bio: Rohit Arora is the CEO and Co-founder of Biz2Credit and Biz2X, leading the company’s vision to transform small business financing through AI-powered digital lending. Since founding Biz2Credit in 2007, he has helped build one of the world’s leading small business financing platforms, processing over USD 37 billion in funding for more than 250,000 businesses. A recognized expert in SME lending and fintech, Rohit oversees the widely cited Biz2Credit Small Business Lending Index and is a member of The Wall Street Journal CEO Council. He is a Senior Contributor to Forbes and is frequently featured in leading global publications, including The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, Bloomberg, MSNBC, and The Washington Post. A Columbia University graduate with a master’s in international business, Rohit is a sought-after speaker at global forums hosted by the World Bank, IMF, IFC, and leading academic institutions.

name: Mr. Rohit Taneja
bio: Rohit Taneja is the founder and CEO of Decentro – India’s fastest-growing API banking platform for financial integrations. As a serial entrepreneur with 12+ years of experience in the payments & banking space, Rohit is a recognized expert in online payments across multiple countries. His interests focus on fintech, banking, blockchain, and sustainability. Before Decentro, Rohit was the founder and CEO of MyPoolin – an Accel Partners-backed payments infrastructure company in India. MyPoolin was later acquired by Wibmo (acquired by PayU in 2019) where Rohit led product & engineering & worked closely with PayU’s management team. Rohit was named an ‘Outstanding Leader’ at Money Conference 2.0 in Dubai (2022) and was awarded the ‘Excellence in Contribution to Ecosystem in Fintech’ and ‘Special Jury’ awards by Assocham (2022). He is a mentor of change at Atal Innovation Mission.

name: Mr. Roshan Regmi
bio: Senior banking and digital transformation leader with experience spanning retail banking, technology, and enterprise change. Over the years, I have led strategic initiatives to modernize legacy systems, scale digital financial services, and embed financial inclusion and sustainability into core business strategy. My approach combines strong governance, risk awareness, and customer-centric design to deliver measurable business outcomes. I am deeply passionate about building institutions that are digitally capable, operationally resilient, and socially responsible — and I welcome conversations on digital transformation, fintech collaboration, and sustainable growth in financial services.

name: Mr. Rumit Shah
bio: Rumit Shah is the Founder & Director of JISA Softech Pvt. Ltd., a cybersecurity and deep-tech company specializing in cryptography, PKI, data protection, and quantum-safe security. With over two decades of experience in the cybersecurity and digital trust ecosystem, he brings extensive expertise in business strategy, cryptographic technologies, and enterprise security. He has been instrumental in building CryptoBind®, JISA’s indigenous cybersecurity technology portfolio spanning Hardware Security Modules (HSM), Key Management, Encryption, Tokenisation, Data Protection, and Post-Quantum Cryptography. A strong advocate for crypto-agility and quantum-safe transformation, Rumit actively engages with industry leaders, financial institutions, government organizations, and the cybersecurity community to advance secure and resilient digital infrastructure.

name: Mr. Sachin Bansal
bio: Sachin Bansal is the Co-Founder and Executive Chairman of the Navi Group. At Navi, he focuses on long-term strategy, technology, and building scalable operating systems across financial services. Under his leadership, Navi has built an integrated financial platform with a mission to simplify finance for a billion Indians through simple, affordable and accessible financial services. Prior to founding Navi in 2018, Sachin co-founded Flipkart and served as its Chief Executive Officer, playing a key role in building one of India’s largest technology companies. He is widely renowned for playing a pivotal role in shaping the consumer internet ecosystem in India and has been instrumental in catalysing the startup and investment landscape. Sachin holds a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Delhi.

name: Mr. Sagar Tanna
bio: Sagar Tanna "Founder and CEO of TSS Consultancy, a company focused on fighting financial crime and simplifying operations through its platforms: Screenzaa for Due Diligence, TrackWizz for Transaction Monitoring, CKYC, and D360 for insider trading compliance. TSS is a regulated entity reporting to IFSCA in GIFT City. He leads a team of 600+ employees that serves 400+ organizations. He is extremely passionate about ensuring compliance without compromise and is a firm believer of Bharat Story.

name: Mr. Sahil Kini
bio: Sahil Kini leads the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (a wholly-owned subsidiary of the RBI), and is passionate about building intuitive and inclusive financial infrastructure for India. He is the Co-Founder and former CEO of Setu, a startup building API infrastructure for banking and financial services. Prior to Setu, Sahil was a Principal at Aspada Investment Advisors. He was also an early team member of Aadhaar, India’s digital ID system, and contributed to the architecture of UPI and Account Aggregator (AA) as a volunteer at iSPIRT. Earlier in his career, he worked at McKinsey & Company, Titan Industries, and Ezetap. Sahil holds a B.Tech in Metallurgy & Materials Engineering from IIT Madras.

name: Mr. Saibal Ghosh
bio: Saibal Ghosh is a Head at HSBC based in London, Greater London. Previously, Saibal was an Investment & Wealth Solutions Head at HSBC and also held positions at CITIC Securities Futures Co., Ltd., Shenzhen Branch, Hongkong &Shanghai Banking Corporation Ltd, and HSBC InvestDirect (India). Saibal received a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of Calcutta and a Program in Leading and Managing from the Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta.

name: Mr. Sainath Pillai
bio: Experienced and driven professional with a strong background in Digital Payments, Specializing in CBDC, UPI, IMPS and BBPS. I have hand-on experience as a Product Manager, working on key platforms like IMPS and BBPS, with a solid understanding of the Indian Payment stack and API based payment systems. My work involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, complaint, and scalable payment solutions. With a proven ability to manage product lifecycles and ensure seamless integration with regulatory and operational frameworks, I focus on delivering high-quality digital payment products. I am committed to leveraging me domain expertise to contribute to impactful projects and work collaboratively with teams to drive innovation in the fintech space.

name: Mr. Sajan Sharma
bio: Sajan Sharma is a Kathmandu-based tech entrepreneur and founder of Citytech, a fintech firm he established in 2018. He is the Immediate Past President of the Fintech Alliance Nepal and remains an influential figure in advancing the country's fintech landscape. Holding a B.S. in Electrical Engineering from Virginia Tech and an Executive MBA from the University of Iowa, Sajan focuses on driving Nepal's digital transformation, building and scaling payment infrastructure across emerging markets, and advocating for tech-friendly foreign investment policies that support innovation and growth.

name: Mr. Sameer Nigam
bio: Sameer Nigam founded PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) in 2015 and serves as its Chief Executive Officer. Before starting PhonePe, Sameer served as Senior Vice President - Engineering and Vice President - Marketing at Flipkart, India’s largest e-commerce platform. His Flipkart journey started in 2011 when the company acquired his earlier startup - Mime360. Mime360 was a digital media distribution platform. Sameer has also served as Director of Product Management at Shopzilla Inc, where he built the company's proprietary shopping search engine. In 2009, he won the coveted Wharton Venture Award, bestowed by the prestigious Wharton Business School. He holds an MBA from Wharton Business School (University of Pennsylvania), USA, and a Master’s degree in Computer Science from University of Arizona, Tucson-USA.

name: Mr. Sammy Mamdani
bio: Sammy Mamdani is Chief Operating Officer at Route Mobile, leading global operations with a focus on execution, collaboration, and scaling delivery across geographies. With 21+ years of international experience, he has built high-performing teams, streamlined operations, and driven customer success and service delivery. He previously served as COO of Cellent Technologies (acquired by Route Mobile in 2016) and held senior roles at Protiviti and Rattonsey Group. At Route Mobile, he is spearheading an AI-driven transformation to automate workflows and enhance operational agility. Sammy holds an MBA from the University of Central Florida.

name: Mr. Sandeep Agarwal
jobTitle: CTO - Security, India and South Asia
bio: Sandeep is the CTO - Security for Cisco, India and South Asia and brings over two decades of security, governance, risk and compliance experience. Prior to Cisco, he was at Google as the security architect for Google Cloud in India. His work involved helping accelerate adoption of Google Cloud in the context of India's regulatory frameworks and building mind share for Google Security among customers, partners and industry associations. Prior to Google, he was VP, Security and Compliance for OakNorth - a cloud-based fintech in the UK. Before OakNorth, he was leading security conversations with Public Sector customers at Amazon Web Services in India and South Asia. Before life in the cloud, Sandeep was the CISO at Max Life Insurance and Moody's Analytics in India, amongst other roles. He holds an MBA from IIM Mumbai, and a B.Tech in CSE from IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. Sandeep is a strong believer and passionate advocate of simplicity and automation in security, risk, and compliance.

name: Mr. Sandeep Batra
bio: Sandeep Batra is the Managing Director & Head of Wealth and Personal Banking, HSBC India, leading the bank’s retail banking, wealth management, private banking, mortgages, cards, lending, insurance and asset management businesses. With over 25 years of international banking experience across India, Thailand, Russia and Singapore, he has played a pivotal role in accelerating HSBC India’s growth in wealth, digital banking and customer-centric innovation. At Global Fintech Fest (GFF), Sandeep brings HSBC’s perspective on the future of financial services, focusing on digital transformation, ecosystem partnerships, AI-led innovation, customer engagement and the evolving expectations of affluent and globally connected customers. His sessions explore how banks can collaborate with fintechs to create seamless, secure and personalised financial experiences while driving sustainable growth.

name: Mr. Sandeep Chagger
bio: Sandeep Chagger is the Managing Director for Africa at Peach Payments, where he leads the company’s strategy, growth and expansion across the continent. With more than a decade of experience across banking, fintech and financial markets, Sandeep believes Africa represents one of the world’s most significant opportunities for innovation, enterprise and economic transformation. He is passionate about enabling businesses across the continent to realise that potential by simplifying the complexity of payments, technology and cross-border commerce, allowing them to operate seamlessly, reach new markets and scale with confidence.

name: Mr. Sandeep Ghule
bio: Fintech professional & a serial entrepreneur. Around 20+ Years of proven track record in building consumer first payment products. After working at ICICI Bank & HSBC, became an entrepreneur in 2011 with co-founding TranServ and built digital payment products. Now, building a credit card business addressing needs of under-served segments at novio

name: Mr. Sandeep Indurkar
bio: Sandeep Indurkar is the Chief Executive Officer of Resilient Payments Private Limited, a BharatPe Group company, where he leads the company's payments business, driving strategy, innovation, and growth across merchant payments, payment acceptance solutions, and strategic banking partnerships. Prior to this, he served as Chief Business Officer, Banking & Alliances at BharatPe and spent over 18 years at ICICI Bank in leadership roles across digital banking and payments. With deep expertise in digital payments and financial services, Sandeep has played a key role in building scalable payment ecosystems and advancing payment innovation in India.

name: Mr. Sandeep Jethwani
bio: Sandeep Jethwani is the Co-founder of Dezerv and the author of The Millionaire Employee. An alumnus of IIM Bangalore, he brings over 19 years of experience in wealth management and has built a career helping India's affluent families make better investment decisions. Before co-founding Dezerv, he led the zero-to-one journey of one of India's leading wealth management firms, scaling its assets under management to over $3.5 billion. Having worked closely with HNIs, UHNIs and family offices, Sandeep has deep insight into the complexities of preserving and growing long-term wealth. At Dezerv, he works closely with the leadership team to shape the company's vision and strategy while driving key initiatives across product, engineering, growth and marketing. Through his writing and public conversations, Sandeep is also passionate about helping startup employees understand equity, ESOPs and long-term wealth creation, making sophisticated financial concepts accessible to a wider audience.

name: Mr. Sanjib Subba
bio: Kathmandu based Financial Inclusion professional with proven track record in Banking, Fintech, Green Finance amongst others.

name: Mr. Sanjiv Purushotham
bio: **Sanjiv Purushotham** | *Fintech Leader & Regional Advisor* Sanjiv Purushotham is a financial services veteran with over three decades of experience driving digital transformation across global markets. Having held senior regional leadership positions at **American Express**, **Mastercard**, and **Citi**, he brings deep strategic and operational expertise to the global fintech ecosystem. Based interchangeably between Singapore and Dubai, Sanjiv acts as a strategic bridge representing premier Singaporean and international fintech companies across the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region. He is widely recognized for his sharp pulse on disruptive technologies, market dynamics, and his passion for leveraging financial technology to foster financial inclusion and social development. Beyond finance, Sanjiv is an aviation enthusiast, an active runner and rower, and a dedicated family man.

name: Mr. Santosh Bhat
jobTitle: Chief Data Scientist and Head of Technologies
bio: Santosh Bhat heads the advanced technologies at Policybazaar.com, that includes data sciences and big data engineering. Under his leadership, Policybazaar has built its own speech recognition systems that work at a huge scale and a best-in-class risk management framework. In this period, he has also developed several best-in-class solutions such as the Customer Data Platform, Big Data Lake, and intent-based CRM. A Post-graduate in Engineering Management from the University of Missouri, USA, and a BTech in mechanical engineering, Santosh brings more than 23 years of experience in data sciences and allied areas.

name: Mr. Sarbvir Singh
bio: Sarbvir Singh, Joint Group CEO, PB Fintech https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarbvirsingh/ Sarbvir has over 25 years of global experience across corporate leadership roles. Currently, he is the CEO of Policybazaar.com, India’s leading insurtech platform and Joint Group CEO of the PB Fintech Group. Prior to joining Policybazaar, he was a venture capitalist and also served in senior leadership positions with digital and media companies. He was most recently the Managing Partner of WaterBridge Ventures, a leading early-stage venture fund. He had also held leadership positions with JP Morgan and Network18 in India, Citi in New York and Emerson Electric in Hong Kong. Sarbvir is a graduate of IIT Delhi and holds an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad.

name: Mr. Sasidhar Thumuluri
bio: Sasi has 20+ years of financial inclusion and capital markets experience in 20+ countries. He started his professional journey at BASIX and went on to pursue international career in impact investments and business strategy at MicroVest, Habitat for Humanity and IFC. He serves on the board of BCFI and advisory board for Center for Analytical Finance of ISB. Sasi has earned two masters’ degrees from Princeton University and Indian Institute of Forest Management.

name: Mr. Saurabh Drolia
bio: Saurabh Drolia is responsible for the Google Pay India consumer experience. Prior to joining Google, Saurabh was the product leader at Microsoft across Seattle, Hyderabad Bangalore. He has led and worked on several teams across the company - Microsoft Teams, Skype Lite, Bing, MSN and Enterprise Health Care. In between his Microsoft journey, he was in the start-up world for a couple of years. Saurabh holds B.S and M.A degrees in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Austin. During his Masters, he was a Research Assistant working on a next generation processor as part of a TRIPS team.

name: Mr. Scott Southall
jobTitle: Head of Domestic and Accounts Payables
bio: In his current role, Scott serves on the Payments leadership team of Citi and is responsible for domestic payments and commercial card products. He focuses on elevating Citi’s network capabilities and creating a comprehensive, end-to-end value proposition across the payables and working capital spectrum for the bank’s clients, helping strengthen the bank’s integrated solutions across Services. He joined Citi in 2011 as the CTS Head of Australia and New Zealand, and he has since held several leadership roles within Services, including Head of Commercial Cards and Innovation for Asia Pacific, and most recently serving as the Global Head of Banking as a Service. Prior to joining Citi, Scott held executive leadership roles in transaction banking, consumer banking and management consulting.

name: Mr. Shailesh Paul
bio: As CEO, Shailesh will lead Wibmo's strategic vision, driving sustainable growth, strengthening our position in the fintech ecosystem, Shailesh is a seasoned payments leader with over two decades of experience across Asia Pacific, India, and the Middle East. He was most recently at Visa, where he served as Global Head of Small Business Acceptance. In his earlier roles at Visa, he led merchant acquiring for India & South Asia, including Cybersource and co-brand partnerships. Shailesh has been a trusted collaborator with PayU and the wider industry, working closely with our teams in the past and playing a key role in driving innovation and shaping growth in the ecosystem. Shailesh also had leadership stints at Standard Chartered Bank and Mastercard previously. Shailesh is an alumnus of the Wharton School of Business AMP, XIMB and Delhi University. Outside of work, he enjoys cooking, music and staying current with global trends.

name: Mr. Sharad Gulhar
bio: Sharad Gulhar is a seasoned fintech leader with over 16 years of experience driving digital payment innovation and scaling businesses across India and Southeast Asia. As Executive Vice President of South East Asia, he leads market expansion, spearheads localized product innovation, builds strong merchant and fintech partner ecosystems, and ensures operational excellence across the board.

name: Mr. Sharath Bulusu
bio: Sharath leads Google Pay in India and has extensive global experience building consumer products across search, media, commerce & fintech. In addition to Google, he has helped create products at Myntra, HouseTrip, Twitter and the Guardian.

name: Mr. Shashank Saxena
bio: Shashank brings technology leadership experience across global financial institutions from Silicon Valley, Wall Street, London, Singapore, and Mumbai. He has held org-wide leadership roles in Engineering and Architecture at respected institutions in global financial markets. An alumnus of BITS Pilani, Shashank serves on the Board of a leading NBFC and on advisory councils for State Governments and Academia in FinTech and AI. An evangelist of Sovereign and Accountable AI, he is building the AI Trust passport for startups to succeed in regulated industries.

name: Mr. Shergeran Roberto Naidoo
bio: Shergeran has served in a number of capacities at PayInc (formerly known as BankservAfrica) - from Compliance and Risk to Legal and Governance and now Head of Stakeholder Engagement. After starting off as a practicing attorney in Pietermaritzburg, Shergeran relocated to Johannesburg where he joined Nedbank, working in Private Banking and Private Clients, as well as Corporate Finance. He later joined Standard Bank as the Corporate Governance Manager and joined PayInc in 2008. Holding a BA (LLB) from the University of KwaZulu-Natal, Shergeran was admitted as an Attorney of the High Court of South Africa in 2000 and holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Tax Law from the University of Johannesburg. Shergeran attained a Masters degree in Business Administration from UNISA Graduate School of Business Leadership in 2013. He is passionate about self-development and serving as a mentor. His favourite role is as a father and husband.

name: Mr. Shiladitya Mukhopadyaya
bio: Shiladitya Mukhopadhyaya is a business leader and entrepreneur with deep expertise at the intersection of technology, growth, and business transformation. As Global Head of Truecaller for Business, he drives go-to-market strategy, partnerships, and revenue growth, positioning Truecaller as the definitive trust layer between businesses and their customers at scale. Prior to Truecaller, Shiladitya played a pivotal role in scaling CleverTap’s enterprise and international business, helping establish the company as a leading customer engagement and analytics platform across global markets. An entrepreneur at heart, Shiladitya has built and led ventures throughout diverse domains. He co-founded multiple consumer technology apps in foodtech, payments and loyalty, prior to which he spent over a decade driving innovation in RFID and automated identification solutions.

name: Mr. Shinichiro Nishikawa
jobTitle: Head of Global Payments Strategy & Transformation

name: Mr. Shivam Sharma
bio: Shivam is a Product Leader at Nucleus Software, with over 10 years of experience in building and scaling enterprise lending platforms across banks and NBFCs. He plays a key role in shaping the evolution of the FinnOne Neo suite, driving innovations across digital loan origination, mobility, and AI-led decisioning. Shivam has been at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies and regulatory frameworks into lending ecosystems, working closely with financial institutions and industry bodies. His work focuses on transforming traditional lending into faster, smarter, and more customer-centric journeys. At the intersection of product strategy and execution, he brings a practitioner’s perspective on how gold loan businesses can leverage digital infrastructure, data intelligence, and seamless customer experiences to unlock the next phase of growth.

name: Mr. Shobhit Mehra
bio: Shobhit Mehra is the Founder & CEO of BoxPay, an AI-powered payments operating system helping enterprises simplify global payments through orchestration, intelligent routing, and AI-driven reconciliation. With nearly two decades of experience across merchant acquiring, card issuing, payment networks, and global commerce, Shobhit has held leadership roles at Expedia Group, American Express, and Axis Bank, managing payment portfolios exceeding US$60 billion across international markets. At BoxPay, he works with enterprises across travel, insurance, retail, and digital commerce to solve complex payment challenges spanning orchestration, cross-border payments, and reconciliation.
