Shobhit helped establish the Merchant Advisory Group (MAG) in APAC to strengthen the merchant voice. He is a Stripe Community Builder for Travel, a RiseUp Mentor with Money20/20, and a frequent speaker on AI, payments, and the future of digital commerce.

name: Mr. Shubhanga Prasad
bio: Shubhanga has been a veteran banker with leadership roles and driving digital initiatives and business at Yes Bank, Oak North Bank. Shubhanga has also been a partner at BetaPlus Capital, a Bangalore based fund, investing in fintech as a space. Shubhanga brings over 2 decade of experience across financial services, technology, and venture investing.

name: Mr. Sivaramakrishnan Iswaran
jobTitle: CEO of Zoho Payment Technologies, and Global Head of Finance and Operations BU
bio: Siva has been with the company since its inception, and has held multiple key positions during his tenure. He has successfully led the development and launch of several products across finance, payments, and operations. He currently leads the growth strategy for Zoho Payments and also serves as the Global Head of the Finance and Operations Business Unit at Zoho. Siva is passionate about building software that addresses real business needs. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics and Finance and resides in Chennai with his family.

name: Mr. Sridhar Narayana
bio: Sridhar is a seasoned Business and Strategy leader with over two decades of experience in the industry. He leads as the CBO at Perfios, where his expertise in driving operational excellence and creating new markets plays a pivotal role in advancing business growth initiatives and enhancing customer experience. Prior to his role at Perfios, Sridhar led the BFSI Business at Adobe India, pioneering the establishment of the Digital Experience vertical for BFSI. Sridhar has managed large cross-functional teams of Sales, Customer Success, Partner team, Solution Consulting, Professional Services, Product Engineering, and aligned product strategy with market opportunities to spearhead the creation of new markets. Before Adobe, Sridhar spent a decade at Microsoft, where he played a key role in driving Consulting Strategy and Sales Excellence across various business units. He began his career journey with ESRI before transitioning to IBM to lead the Mid-Market Business.

name: Mr. Sriram Venkateswaran
bio: Sriram Venkateswaran heads Engineering for Consumer Experiences, UPI Platform and Partnership Engineering initiatives for Google Pay India. He is based out of Google’s Bangalore office. He is very passionate about solving fintech problems at scale including Agentic Commerce / Payments. Prior to joining Google, he was the Group CTO at Trusting Social - Earlier, he was the CTPO at rootVX, a cryptography based asset tokenization startup, SVP (Engineering) at Polygon Labs, Director(Engineering) at Coinbase, VP (App Engineering) at Flipkart / Myntra and Head of Research Labs at Ola. Sriram has a Bachelors of Engineering degree from NIT Trichy. He holds over fifteen patents in various fields in Technology and is also author of “Embedded Realtime Systems Programming” (McGrawHill) which is one of the standard texts for the subject in Indian Universities.

name: Mr. Sujeet Tyagi
bio: Sujeet Tyagi is the Chief Operating Officer at Montra India, where he leads strategic operations and drives the execution of mission-critical financial infrastructure initiatives. With extensive global experience in payments system implementation, he has played a key role in delivering large-scale, real-time payment solutions across diverse markets. Sujeet specializes in overseeing end-to-end program delivery, aligning business objectives with technology, and ensuring regulatory and operational excellence. Known for his leadership and execution focus, he has successfully managed cross-functional teams and complex stakeholder environments worldwide. His expertise spans payment modernization, clearing and settlement systems, and digital transformation, making him a trusted leader in the evolving global payments landscape.

name: Mr. Sumit Nigam
bio: Sumit is an accomplished technology leader with over 26 years of experience in the software industry. As the Chief Technology Officer at Perfios, Sumit is dedicated to driving technological innovation and excellence within the organization. His expertise in architecting cutting-edge solutions and navigating complex technical landscapes positions him as a key driver in advancing Perfios' technological capabilities and ensuring a seamless experience for customers. Throughout his career, Sumit has held key roles at prestigious technical organizations such as Verisign, EMC, Informatica, Walmart Global Tech, and Bigbasket. He has seamlessly transitioned from hands-on technical architect roles to leadership positions, overseeing entire engineering functions. Sumit's contributions have been instrumental in establishing robust teams and pioneering engineering best practices across diverse geographical domains.

name: Mr. Surendra Kumar Vishwakarma
bio: Shri Surendra Kumar Vishwakarma is presently serving as General Manager, HO IT Division at Punjab National Bank since 2025, bringing with him over 30 years of rich experience in Banking Operations and Information Technology. Prior to his current assignment, he served as Deputy General Manager in HO IT and Operations Divisions, and as Circle Head/DGM at Corporate Office Udaipur. Throughout his career, he has handled critical responsibilities including Head of ATM & Payment Systems, Hardware/CTS/CDKs/PBKs & SWIFT, Network Management, and Incharge of the ePayment Solution Cell. His areas of expertise encompass Core Banking Solutions, IT Infrastructure & Operations, Digital Banking, Payment Systems, Disaster Recovery, and Strategic Banking Operations.

name: Mr. Tajinder Singh
bio: Tajinder Singh joined the IOSCO General Secretariat in January 2010 as Deputy Secretary General. He was previously Head of International Affairs & Human Resource Development and Advisor to the Chairman of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). Mr. Singh comes from the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and has held various positions in the Ministry of Finance in the Government of India, as well as handling a number of assignments for the government in the financial and other sectors. He has over 30 years of experience at senior leadership positions in different organizations dealing with strategic issues in regulation, finance and administration, and significant domestic and international experience dealing with Government and regulators. Mr. Singh holds a Master’s degree in Systems Science and Automation from the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore, and graduated in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur.

name: Mr. Takeo Ueno
bio: Mr. Ueno holds expertise in system development in transaction banking and new business production in the card and payment area at NTT DATA. Business consultant in the Fintech area at NTT DATA Corporation company. He can be attributed to overseas business development in the Hong Kong and India subsidiaries of NTT DATA as local division director. Currently handling corporate management in the Company as a Whole-time Director and Chief Executive Officer.

name: Mr. Takeshi Kito
bio: Takeshi is a serial Fintech entrepreneur, and Co-founder & CEO of GFTN Japan, actively spearheading ecosystem building and international collaborations. Additionally, he sits on the committee for the Government of Japan's Regulatory Sandbox and is a member of the experts group, jointly organized by the Digital Agency and the Ministry of Economy, Trade, and Industry focusing on international data governance. Before starting his own startup in the Fintech industry, Takeshi worked as an investment banker at Merrill Lynch, gaining expertise in capital markets. Prior to joining Merrill Lynch, he worked at Boston Consulting Group. He formerly served as Vice-chair at Fintech Association of Japan, where he played a pivotal role in navigating international collaborations for 6 years.

name: Mr. Takuya Senoo
jobTitle: Executive Officer, Managing Director, Head of India and Sri Lanka, CEO for India
bio: Takuya Senoo is the CEO for India, MUFG Bank India and Head of Sri Lanka. He spearheads the strategy of the banking business in the region of India and Sri Lanka at the same time also ensures on the safety and soundness of operations.

name: Mr. Tejas Goenka
bio: Tejas is working on making the connected business environment a reality for SMEs via the next-generation Tally product roadmap. Tejas’ customer-centric approach has driven Tally’s strong selling and servicing partner network to a more accountable, higher-quality network, resulting in aggressive business growth. Living the philosophy of simplifying the lives of MSMEs with technology, Tejas led Tally’s transition into the GST era, taking it to a 2.6 million+ strong license base.

name: Mr. Tejas Maniar
bio: TEJAS MANIAR Chief Digital & Liabilities Officer Tejas Maniar joined Fino Payments Bank in April 2022 as Chief Digital Officer (CDO) to build and scale up its Fino 2.0 strategy, with digital transformation at its helm. He started out when digital was at a nascent stage and has built credible experience of over 2 decades with organizations like HDFC Bank and IDFC FIRST Bank setting up digital domains including products, applications, business and sales. Tejas has been instrumental in driving Fino’s end-to-end digital transformation agenda, scaling our technology platforms for future growth and ensuring integration of digital banking across all channels and services. He also manages the Liabilities Product portfolio, spearheading the Bank’s overall liability strategy including design, development & implementation of new products, while ensuring profitability & competitive advantage.

name: Mr. Tim Mathews
bio: Tim Mathews is the Co-Founder & CEO of Finsall, India's pioneering insurance premium financing platform, focused on making insurance more affordable and accessible through innovative financing solutions. With over two decades of experience spanning financial services, strategy, consulting, and entrepreneurship, Tim has played a key role in building Finsall into a category-defining fintech at the intersection of lending and insurance. Prior to founding Finsall, he held leadership positions across consulting, investment advisory, and global engineering organizations. Tim holds an MBA in Finance and Entrepreneurship from Washington University in St. Louis – Olin Business School and a B.Tech from IIT Madras. He is a recognized thought leader in insurtech, embedded finance, and financial inclusion.

name: Mr. Tom David Mutton
bio: Tom is Executive Director, Fintech and Payments Innovation at the Bank of England. Tom leads the Bank’s strategy on frontier technologies and their implications for the financial system and economy. This work focuses on artificial intelligence, distributed ledger technology, and quantum computing. Tom also leads the Bank's work on payments innovation, across retail, wholesale, and cross border payments. Tom has a breath of experience in finance, regulation, international policy, and technology strategy. His previous roles at the Bank include Director of Fintech, Head of International Policy and Strategy, Head of Division in Prudential Policy and time as a Senior Manager responsible for the supervision of major international firms. He was educated at the London School of Economics.

name: Mr. Utkarsh Shukla
bio: Hi, I’m Utkarsh Shukla, Chief AI Officer and CoFounder at Ringg.ai. I work on building production-grade AI voice agents that can handle real-world business conversations reliably. My work focuses on multilingual conversational AI, prompt and model evaluation, STT-LLM-TTS pipelines, low-latency inference, and improving call quality through real-time analytics. I come from a background in cloud engineering and backend systems, and I’m passionate about building practical AI systems that are safe, scalable, and useful for enterprises.

name: Mr. Vaibhav Tambe
bio: Vaibhav Tambe spent more than a decade inside India’s banks before co-founding TBX, the corporate banking infrastructure company connecting banks, enterprises, and businesses at scale. At SBI he became one of the youngest Assistant Vice Presidents in the bank’s history at 26. At IndusInd Bank, he rose from Regional Sales Manager to Country Head within a decade, leading Transaction Banking, Payments, Escrows, and Capital Markets nationally. He was recognised as “Emerging Star of the Year,” “Superstar of the Year,” and recipient of the Asset Triple A Asian Award. He later served as President and CEO of Payments at iServeU, and is an active angel investor across fintech, blockchain, EVs, and edtech. In 2022, he co-founded TBX to reimagine how banks and businesses work together. He holds an MBA from IMT Ghaziabad and has been recognised as one of the “Most Admired Fintech Professionals” globally.

name: Mr. Varun Khullar
bio: Varun Khullar is the Chief Revenue Officer, Yubi Group. He is a revenue and growth leader with over two decades of experience building and scaling businesses across financial services, technology, and industry. His career spans enterprise sales, product, partnerships, and general management, and he pairs the analytical rigour of a strategist with the instincts of an operator, having led businesses through new-market entry, enterprise expansion, and product-led growth.

name: Mr. Varun Malhotra
bio: Varun Malhotra, Partner at Quona Capital, has over 15 years of venture investing experience across technology, financial services and impact. Varun co-heads Quona’s investments across India and SE Asia. Quona is the leading global fintech VC with ~$ 1bn in AUM and 75+ investments across LatAm, India & SE Asia, MENA & sub-Saharan Africa. Varun has led Quona's investments in Shivalik SFB, Arya.ag, Upswing & Turno. Varun is a Kauffman Fellow and is a Forbes 30 under 30 honouree for Venture Capital in Asia.

name: Mr. Vasanth Kamath
bio: Vasanth Kamath is the CEO of smallcase (leading model portfolios platform) & a Trustee Director at Zerodha Fund House (fastest growing passive asset manager). In the last 10 years, the company has grown into a leading provider of investment & technology solutions to capital market players. Across their offerings, smallcase has helped over 10 million investors build better long-term portfolios across stocks, ETFs, mutual funds and global equities

name: Mr. Vibhav Hathi
bio: Vibhav holds 20+ years of experience across product management, digital banking, and credit card portfolio management. He was the key force behind the launch of FASTag. Prior to OneCard, he founded ‘Open Canvas’—a mobile-based transaction platform—to drive interoperable digital payments in key "offline" payment scenarios like mass transit (metros, buses), parking, fuel, etc. He holds a BE in Chemical Engineering from The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda and an MBA from IIM Calcutta.

name: Mr. Vignesh Kumaran Subramaniam
bio: Vignesh Kumaran, Head of Products and Product Strategy at KFin Technologies, is a seasoned wealth management professional with 12+ years of experience. He has driven product innovation across the domestic wealth industry, with prior roles at ICICI Prudential and Kotak MF. An MBA graduate, Vignesh combines academic grounding with hands-on expertise in digital product development, making him a strong voice in wealth management and fintech.

name: Mr. Vijay Krishnamurthy
bio: Vijay Krishnamurthy, Managing Director & CEO of India International Exchange (India INX), is widely regarded as a leading innovator in India’s fixed-income and cross-border market ecosystem. His product vision, regulatory depth, and market-building leadership are steering India INX toward becoming a globally competitive exchange within GIFT City IFSC.

name: Mr. Vijay Ramakrishnaiyer Mani
bio: Vijay leads Banking & Capital Markets for Deloitte India. He has over 3 decades of financial services consulting experience spanning strategy, business planning, organisational transformation, technology and M&A in India, as well as in Canada, the UK and South East Asia. Vijay’s core area of speciality is complex transformation in the payments domain, particularly technology-led transformation programs sharply focused on business outcomes. Vijay has an MBA (PGPX) from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad, a CFA charter from the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) Institute (USA), and a Bachelor of Commerce from the University of Mumbai.

name: Mr. Vikas Panwar
bio: Vikas Panwar is associated with the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) as the Country Manager – India. He serves as the authorised representative for the GLEIF India Office and plays a key role in engaging with regulators, policymakers, financial institutions, and key stakeholders to drive awareness, adoption, and broader usage of the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) in India.

name: Mr. Vikash Jalan
bio: Mr. Vikash Jalan is the Chief Operating Officer at Paytm and Chief Executive Officer of Nearbuy. Since joining Paytm in 2019, he has led several of the company’s largest consumer businesses, including UPI, Recharges & Bill Payments, Travel, Transit, and Gift Vouchers, driving innovation and growth at scale. With over 20 years of leadership experience across fintech, consumer internet, digital commerce, and travel, he has built and transformed large-scale businesses serving millions of customers. Prior to his current role, he served as CEO of Paytm Travel, leading its successful turnaround. Earlier, he co-founded RentOnGo and held leadership roles at Flipkart, Goldman Sachs, and Infosys.

name: Mr. Vikram Raichura
bio: With over two decades of leadership experience in building and scaling high-growth technology organizations, I have played a pivotal role in shaping organizational strategy, leadership capability, and business transformation at Helo.ai by VivaConnect. Working closely with executive leadership, I have helped create high-performing teams, drive organizational excellence, and enable sustainable growth in the rapidly evolving technology and fintech ecosystem. My experience spans business transformation, leadership development, governance, talent strategy, and organizational effectiveness, with a strong focus on aligning people, culture, and business outcomes. Having worked alongside founders and senior leadership through multiple phases of growth and innovation, I bring a strategic perspective on leadership, execution, and organizational impact. I look forward to recognizing organizations that demonstrate innovation, business excellence, and lasting value for customers, employees, and the industry.

name: Mr. Vikram Sahu
bio: Vikram Sahu is India CEO, Bank of America N.A and is also the Country Executive of the firm’s India franchise. He is on the bank’s Asia Pacific Executive Committee and is based in Mumbai. Vikram is responsible for leading and driving the strategic direction of the business in India and for strengthening client relationships in the country. Vikram drives and promotes a culture of Responsible Growth and brings to the role exceptional global perspective and three decades of experience, having held roles in London, Mumbai, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York. Prior to this role, Vikram was the head of Global Equity Research based in New York. He holds a bachelor's degree from St. Stephen's College, Delhi, and attained a master's degree in the U.S.

name: Mr. Vineet Sethi
bio: Vineet Sethi is the Chief Growth and Marketing officer at PayU. In his current role, he drives PayU’s strategic growth verticals including Government, SMB, Start-ups, Omnichannel, D2C, and PayU Insights. He also leads critical business functions such as Marketing, Branding, PR, and Partnerships for the company. Vineet brings over two decades of experience in the BFSI space with a successful track record of building and scaling business lines in his earlier stints. He has held leadership roles across business development, sales, product management, marketing, and strategy. Before joining PayU, Vineet was Chief Marketing Officer at Niyo, where he played an instrumental role in building and scaling their flagship offering Niyo Global. He has deep BFSI expertise from his work at Standard Chartered Bank & ICICI Bank, where he led Credit Cards, Personal Loans and Employee banking businesses. Vineet is based in Mumbai.

name: Mr. Viram Shah
bio: Viram Shah is the Funder and CEO of Vested Finance, a global investing platform helping Indian investors access international markets. Vested enables cross-border investing across global equities and other international investment products, with a focus on simplifying access, compliance, custody, and investor experience for Indian residents and Global Indians. With $1B+ in assets under administration and $6B+ in trading volume processed, Vested is a leading platform in the global investing space in India. Viram works at the intersection of fintech, capital markets, payments and cross-border regulation. His current focus is on expanding global investing access for Indians through regulated infrastructure across the US, GIFT City, and other international markets. He is also actively involved in building products across global equities, fixed income, private markets, and multi-currency investment solutions.

name: Mr. Vishal Anand Kanvaty
bio: Vishal Anand Kanvaty, CTO, National Payments Corporation of India — architect of UPI's scale journey, 26 years in financial services, now leading AI-driven fraud prevention, and DLT innovation at NPCI.

name: Mr. Vishwas Patel
bio: Mr. Vishwas Patel is the Joint Managing Director at Infibeam Avenues Limited (""IAL"" or ""Company""), and Founder & CEO of the Company's Payments business. Mr. Vishwas Patel is the founder of the payment gateway brand, CCAvenue, founded in the year 2001. CCAvenue is among the top 3 online payment gateway platforms in India and also ranks number 2 in the UAE among non-bank private digital payment companies.

name: Mr. Vivek Agarwal
bio: Vivek Agarwal is the Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at Square Yards. Square Yards is India's largest Integrated real estate platform, with category leadership in housing transactions, mortgage, home interiors & property management. Vivek has 20+ years of rich experience in leading complex global strategic initiatives with some of world's largest companies like Intel, Nokia and Accenture. Vivek is MBA from IIM Mumbai and BTech from JC Bose University of Science & Technology

name: Mr. Vivek Gupta
bio: Vivek Gupta is a dynamic business leader with more than 2 decades of experience in FinTech Ops, Customer Lifecycle Management, and Process Automation. He has been at the forefront of leveraging AI, analytics, and emerging tech to reimagine customer experience and drive operational efficiency. He has hands on AI-driven fraud detection models, automated credit risk monitoring, chatbot-enabled customer support, bringing tech and ops together to deliver faster, smarter, and more secure solutions.

name: Mr. Yannick Schneider
bio: Yannick Schneider has been working as Head of Regulatory Solutions since 2018. His focus is on advising internationally active financial institutions and corporations. In his role, he develops measures to implement regulatory requirements relating to the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) and identifies ways to optimize processes and reduce costs. Prior to joining Bundesanzeiger Verlag GmbH, the graduate in social and political sciences worked in Business Development at an internationally active IT consulting firm. There, Mr. Schneider acquired and managed strategic IT and innovation projects for well-known companies across industries.

name: Mr. Yash Desai
bio: Yash Desai is the Co-founder of ZET, where he drives growth, partnerships, and marketing to power the company’s distribution engine across Bharat. With over 11 years of business leadership experience, he blends strategic vision with executional rigour to bridge India’s credit gap and unlock financial mobility through better credit scores. Previously, Yash served as business head at Dineout, where he played a pivotal role in scaling the platform into a category leader in India’s dining space. He led strategy, sales, and regional operations across Mumbai, Goa, and Ahmedabad, delivering scale through marquee initiatives like the Great Indian Restaurant Festival. Passionate about consumer engagement and financial empowerment, he continues to build innovative pathways that drive growth and impact at scale.

name: Mr. Yogi Rajkumar Sadana
bio: Yogi Sadana is the Founder and CEO of Zype, a fully digital consumer lending company built to serve India's emerging middle class. With over 20 years in financial services, Yogi founded Zype with a clear conviction: that a young, salaried borrower in a Tier 2 or Tier 3 city deserves the same speed, simplicity, and fairness in credit as anyone else. Zype is a disciplined and responsible digital lender with 100% automated underwriting, no paperwork, and money in the customer's account within 10 minutes while ensuring full regulatory compliance. The company achieved profitability within two years of launch. Yogi is a Chartered Accountant (India) and CPA (USA), a member of FACE, and an active voice on responsible lending, financial inclusion, and the future of sustainable digital credit in India.

name: Mr. Yuvraj Singh Shekhawat
bio: Yuvraj leads the Offline Organised Business vertical at PhonePe. He along with his team was instrumental in the establishment of the the offline retail business vertical from scratch at PhonePe. Yuvraj has effectively transformed the payments experience for the category across diverse segments like F&B, grocery, fuel, dairy, healthcare, transit, lifestyle and consumer electronics amongst others. Prior to PhonePe, Yuvraj was working with Flipkart as an Associate Director leading Key Account Management for the Mens clothing super category. In his career spanning over a decade, he has worked with leading corporations including Colgate Palmolive, Wipro and Asian Paints building expertise in the sphere of key account management, sales, rural and urban distribution networks along with strategies for business and market growth as well as expansion. Yuvraj holds an MBA degree in marketing and finance from MDI, Gurgaon.

name: Mrs. Disha Dubey
bio: Disha Dubey is a Senior AI Engineer at NVIDIA, where she helps enterprises build production machine learning systems that drive real business decisions. With leadership roles at U.S. Bank, DataRobot, and Kumo, she brings deep expertise in designing scalable AI/ML solutions from prototype to production. At NVIDIA and Kumo, Disha worked closely with customers to build and deploy graph transformers at scale - experience she now brings to the forefront of financial AI. Her work sits at the intersection of graph AI, real-time fraud detection, and intelligent financial networks, translating cutting-edge research into systems that deliver measurable business impact across product, engineering, and risk teams.

name: Mrs. Praveena Rai
bio: Ms. Praveena Rai is the Managing Director & CEO of Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd. (MCX), India’s largest commodity derivatives Exchange. Her illustrious career spans over 30 years in financial services. Prior to joining MCX, she was the Chief Operating Officer with National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), wherein she has successfully executed the growth strategy for digital payments. She has also held leadership positions in Citi Group, HSBC and Kotak Mahindra Bank and believes that technology is a key engine driving transformative change, critical in accelerating the transition to a digital services led economy. She is an engineer and a management postgraduate from College of Engineering, Guindy and Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad. She has been awarded by Forbes in the Self-Made Women List 2024.

name: Mrs. Priti Gupta
bio: Priti Rathi Gupta, Founder of LXME, and Co-Promoter Anand Rathi Group has led and inspired over a million women towards building their financial acumen and financialization of their savings. with over 27 years of experience in the financial services industry, Priti has played a key role in building the Anand Rathi Group into one of India’s largest and most trusted financial services conglomerates, managing $10 billion in AUM. Her expertise spans capital markets, commodities, and currency sectors. She has held leadership roles in YPO as Chapter chair and Learning officer. An alumnus of Harvard Business School, She is also actively involved in Mumbai’s start-up ecosystem.

name: Mrs. Rasika Prashant
bio: Rasika Prashant is the Chief Executive Officer of NSRCEL, the startup incubator of the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB). An accomplished entrepreneur and business leader, she previously co-founded Soulfull and served as its Chief Marketing Officer, playing a pivotal role in building it into one of India's leading millet-based food brands before its acquisition by Tata Consumer Products. With deep expertise in entrepreneurship, brand building, innovation, and business scaling, Rasika now leads NSRCEL's mission of empowering founders through world-class incubation, mentorship, strategic partnerships, and access to capital and markets. She is widely recognized for her founder-first approach and her commitment to strengthening India's innovation and startup ecosystem.

name: Ms. Aditi Mittal
bio: Aditi Mittal is a leading voice in India's fixed income and debt capital markets ecosystem. As Director of A.K. Group and Co-Founder of IndiaBonds, she has spent over two decades working across investment banking, debt markets, wealth solutions and fintech innovation. She has played a significant role in expanding access to bond investing, helping bridge the gap between institutional and retail participation in fixed income markets. Aditi currently serves as Chairperson of the Online Bond Platform Providers Association of India (OBPPAI) and National Co-Chairperson of ASSOCHAM's Corporate Bond Committee, contributing actively to industry development and policy dialogue.

name: Ms. Anoushka Dua
jobTitle: Head – Asia South and JANA Payments, Citi

name: Ms. Christine Tan
jobTitle: Head of Asia Pacific- Financial Institutions Group (FIG) Sales
bio: Christine Tan (Jang) is Managing Director and Head of Asia Pacific – Financial Institutions Group for J.P. Morgan Payments, based in Singapore. In this role, she will assume leadership responsibility for banks, broker-dealers and non-bank financial institutions portfolios across the region, providing strategic advice and capturing opportunities to grow our business with both existing and new clients. Prior to this position, Christine was Head of Treasury Services, ASEAN for responsible for embedding the end-to-end TS model in every market across Indonesia, Malaysia, Pakistan, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam, ensuring resiliency and robustness in product offering, service model and control environment. She was also the Head of multinational corporates (MNCs) for Asia Pacific for five years and has a wealth of MNC experience in the region across multiple key markets.

name: Ms. Dee Low
bio: Dee is a seasoned financial services executive with over two decades of experience spanning transactional banking, risk & governance and strategic partnerships. Prior to joining Nexus Global Payments, she was leading Transactional FX for the Asian region at a major global bank, navigating complex markets and driving growth in competitive environments.

name: Ms. Frances Choo
bio: Frances Choo is the Group Head of Products & Partnerships at NTT DATA Payment Services, where she leads the Group's product strategy, innovation and partner ecosystem across the region. She is responsible for driving the growth of the company's payment solutions while delivering greater value to merchants, partners and customers. With over 20 years of experience spanning legal practice and retail banking, Frances brings extensive expertise in product management, business development, portfolio management and digital transformation. Prior to this, she served as Senior Vice President, Retail Banking at AmBank, where she led initiatives in SME and secured lending, digital banking, innovation, alternative channels, and Basel and MFRS 9 implementation. Frances holds a Bachelor of Laws (LLB Hons) from the University of Wales, Cardiff, and an MBA in Finance from the University of Leicester, UK.

name: Ms. Jo Yeo
jobTitle: Head of the Payments Development and Data Connectivity Office at the FinTech & Innovation Group (FTIG)
bio: Jo is Division Head of the Payments Development and Data Connectivity Office at the FinTech & Innovation Group (FTIG), Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS). She oversees the development of Singapore’s payments ecosystem and cross-border data connectivity. Jo has led key initiatives such as Direct FAST, PayNow cross-border linkages with Thailand, India and Malaysia, Project Nexus, SGQR, the Payments Council, and the cessation of cheques in Singapore. Previously, she was project director for the Payment Services Act. Before joining FTIG, Jo was Assistant General Counsel at MAS, advising on financial regulations and trade agreements. She began her legal career at Allen & Gledhill and Amica Law. Jo holds an LLB (Hons) from the National University of Singapore and an LLM from University College London and is a non-practising solicitor of England and Wales.

name: Ms. Karina Ley Chinguel Degregori
bio: Karina is a Partner at Vodanovic, a leading boutique law firm in Peru specializing in banking, financial regulation, FinTech and payments. She has over 17 years of public- and private-sector experience and advises leading financial institutions and global FinTech companies on digital financial services and regulatory strategy. She holds an LL.M. in Banking and Finance Law from Queen Mary University of London, graduating with Distinction, and a law degree from the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru (PUCP), graduating with Highest Honors. She was also a scholarship recipient at Peru’s Securities Market Superintendency and completed ESAN University’s Corporate Finance and Capital Markets Program. Karina is recognized as a thought leader in financial regulation, capital markets and digital finance. She works closely with financial regulators on modernization initiatives and reforms supporting the sector’s digital transformation. She is also a lecturer at PUCP and Thomson Reuters.

name: Ms. Lalitha Nataraj
bio: Ms. Lalitha Nataraj is the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of NPCI BHIM Services Limited.She oversees the strategic and operational direction of NBSL, focusing on strengthening UPI-based payment solutions for recurring transactions And, ensures alignment with NPCI’s broader goals of fostering a secure and accessible digital payments ecosystem. Lalitha is interested in how emerging technologies can enhance financial services.She also mentors young professionals and supports fintech innovation efforts.

name: Ms. Latika S Kundu
org: Metropolitan Stock Exchange of India Ltd.

name: Ms. Mridula Iyer
jobTitle: Asia South Head of Services , Citi

name: Ms. Nikita Tambday
bio: Nikita Tambday is an Executive Director and Head of Products for Treasury Services in India for J.P. Morgan, based in Mumbai. In this role, Nikita is responsible for delivering market leading solutions to clients by leveraging J.P. Morgan's unique global strengths couples with local capabilities across Payments and Commerce solutions, Digital Channels as well as Liquidity & Account Services. Nikita joined J.P. Morgan in 2018 and brings more than 20 years of experience across the Transaction banking spectrum. Prior to joining J.P. Morgan Nikita was leading the Cash Management Product division of BNP Paribas India and leading the Digital Channels Product team of ICICI Bank prior to that. Throughout her career, Nikita has held various leadership roles in the Product management and Digital Channels domain, demonstrating a strong tack record of product innovation and delivering agile differentiated banking solutions across industry segments.

name: Ms. Pallavi Shrivastava
bio: Pallavi Shrivastava is the Co-Founder of Progcap, an MSME Fintech working to empower the underserved MSMEs in India with financing and digitization solutions. Working at the intersection of software and financial services, Progcap digitizes, automates and eases capital movement across the supply chain to MSMEs that have remained excluded from the formal financial ecosystem. Prior to founding Progcap, she worked with the International Finance Corporation and the World Bank Group. She is a Stanford Executive Program alumna and holds an engineering degree and an MBA from XLRI, Jamshedpur.

name: Ms. Paroma Chatterjee
bio: Paroma Chatterjee is a seasoned Banking, Fintech and Digital Consumer Business professional with more than two decades of experience working with some of the leading Global and Indian organisations. She joined Revolut in April 2021 to take charge as the CEO of Revolut India. Revolut India is a wholly owned subsidiary of London headquartered global Fintech company, Revolut Group, which is the UK’s fastest growing private tech company and one of Europe’s largest FinTechs. In her capacity as India CEO, Paroma has made Revolut one of just two global companies to obtain the necessary licenses and authorisations from the RBI, to build and launch the first of its kind integrated app in India that combines digital wallets with domestic UPI payments, along with prepaid Visa cards for both local and multi-currency international spending. Paroma is also a member of IAMAI's governing council and FICCI’s fintech committee.

name: Ms. Prachi Dharani
bio: Prachi Dharani is a seasoned payments industry leader with over 20 years of experience and the Co-founder and CEO of PayGlocal. She leads acquiring, issuing, and P&L functions, driving the company’s mission to simplify cross-border payments for Indian businesses through secure, seamless, and high-success-rate payment experiences. Before founding PayGlocal, Prachi held leadership roles at Visa, First Data, and ICICI Bank. As Senior Director and Head of Digital Specialized Sales for India & South Asia at Visa, she contributed to the growth of digital payments across the region. At First Data, she led e-commerce product innovation and strategic growth, while at ICICI Bank, she was part of the merchant acquiring business. Under her leadership, PayGlocal continues to enable businesses to grow globally with reduced fraud risk, improved payment success rates, and smoother international transactions.

name: Ms. Presha Paragash
bio: Presha Paragash is a Wholetime Director and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Credit Saison India and had joined the Company in 2018. She holds an MBA degree from Wharton and is a BsC graduate from London School of Economics. Prior to joining Credit Saison India, Presha comes with over 15+ years of experience in the financial services domain

name: Ms. Ritu Singh
bio: With over 14 years of experience in broadcast journalism, Ritu leads the coverage of India’s financial sector, corporate developments, and macro-economic policy at CNBC-TV18. She regularly presents evening business bulletins that break down complex financial stories for a wide audience. She is also known for her in-depth coverage of RBI policy decisions. Ritu hosted flagship show Mad About Markets, for India’s new-age investors. She also co-hosts Startup Street, a daily show dedicated to India’s startup ecosystem.

name: Ms. Sagrika Shah
bio: Sagrika has been former co-founder at Connexdoor, and quite passionate about tracking different investment markets and products. She currently is associated with Aagama Ventures, a fintech only fund.

name: Ms. Salila Pande
bio: Ms. Pande, Deputy Managing Director in State Bank of India (SBI) has been an integral part of State Bank of India (SBI), India’s oldest and largest banking group for almost three decades. During her banking career Ms. Pande has held key leadership positions in the Bank, in India and abroad. In her previous role, she was the Chief General Manager of Mumbai Metro Circle, where she spearheaded retail business of the Bank’s key financial market. Prior to that she served as the President & CEO of SBI, California, a US Chartered Bank and a wholly owned subsidiary of SBI, where she skillfully steered the Bank’s growth amidst an uncertain economic environment due to COVID-19, among others.

name: Ms. Santosh Dujari
jobTitle: Head of Services - Indian Subcontinent, Citi
bio: Santosh is a seasoned Transaction Banker with 24 years of experience across varied roles in Sales, Product and Operations covering Local Corporates, Multinationals and Financial Institutions. She is responsible for driving business growth, sales, strategy, client relationships, product innovation and delivery through collaboration and partnership, elevating talent and grooming leaders. Prior to this role, she was CCPS & FI Sales Head for India. Before moving to Sales, she managed a Product portfolio as P&L owner and business manager which was preceded by an Operations stint across multiple roles from business development to business process outsourcing. Santosh has been championing various CSR initiatives for Citi, earlier the Akshaya Patra foundation and currently The Hunger Project in India.

name: Ms. Seema Prem
bio: Seema Prem is the Co-Founder & CEO of FIA Global, a social-impact fintech advancing financial inclusion for underserved communities across South Asia. Influenced by her childhood spent in some of the most inaccessible terrains in India, Seema felt compelled to work towards reducing the inequities she saw. A United Nations Women Transforming India awardee, Seema leads the development of technology-driven, human-centric solutions that empower individuals without access to financial services, creating scalable and sustainable impact. Her work focuses on reducing financial exclusion, supporting poverty alleviation, and enabling people to move from access to long-term economic resilience.

name: Ms. Shereen Bhan
bio: Shereen Bhan has over two decades of experience in the field of Television Broadcast, tracking corporate, policy news and business landscape. Shereen has been producing and anchoring flagship, award winning shows like 'India Business Hour' and ‘Young Turks’, a series that over the last 20 years has successfully built a niche category in business news programming.

name: Ms. Shilpa Mankar Ahluwalia
bio: Shilpa Mankar Ahluwalia leads the FinTech and Banking & Finance Practice at Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co., with a strong focus on financial services and M&A transactions. She has advised several leading fintech platforms in connection with their products and solutions in India. She has led several policy initiatives in collaboration with the Digital Lenders Association of India. Shilpa has also advised various companies, banks and financial institutions in connection with their financing activities as well as specialised financial products. She was also on the government drafting committee for the Factoring Act.

name: Ms. Shobhita Agarwal
bio: Shobhita Agarwal is the Co-Founder and CEO of craftAI, where she is building an Agentic AI platform for the lending industry. A technology and product leader with 15 years of experience across AI, fintech, and enterprise technology, she has previously built AI agents and intelligent automation solutions for leading U.S. financial services companies. Today, she is focused on using AI to transform lending operations, making them more intelligent, automated, and capable of delivering measurable business outcomes.

name: Ms. Shruti Gupta
jobTitle: Head of Commercial & Money Movement Solutions, India and South Asia
bio: Shruti Gupta is the Head of Commercial & Money Movement Solutions (CMS) for India and South Asia at Visa. She leads the multi-year growth strategy for CMS, working closely with the INSA leadership team. With over two decades of experience across commercial banking, MNCs, risk management, strategy, and the startup ecosystem, Shruti brings deep expertise to her role. She spent 24 years at Citi, where she held multiple leadership roles across lending and non-lending segments, including business development and relationship management. Most recently, she served as Managing Director for the multinational segment at Citi Commercial Banking.

name: Ms. Shweta Bajpai
jobTitle: Group Director - Financial Services, Media, Travel and Real Estate
bio: Shweta Bajpai is Group Director for Financial Services, Media, Travel and Real Estate at Meta India. She drives Meta's partnerships and business growth strategy across the financial services sector, helping banks, insurers, fintechs, and investment firms leverage Meta's platforms to reach and engage customers at scale. With extensive experience in building strategic industry verticals, Shweta brings deep insight into how digital platforms are transforming financial services and customer engagement across emerging markets.

name: Ms. Sonali Shelke
bio: Sonali Shelke is an Executive Director at JPMorganChase, where she leads fintech coverage in India for the Payments business. She works with India-headquartered fintechs and large global fintech clients with operations in India, collaborating closely with product, compliance, and technology teams to design and deliver solutions for a fast-growing, dynamic market. With 15+ years in banking sales and coverage, Sonali has spent 10+ years focused on fintech and built strong relationships with top Indian and global players in India. Beyond her core responsibilities, she is actively engaged in DOI initiatives including Global Women in Payments and Autism@Work, where she has led multiple events and initiatives. Sonali holds an MBA from IIM Lucknow and a bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering from Pune University.

name: Ms. Sonia Kaul
bio: Sonia Kaul is the Chief Solutions Officer at Karix, a Tanla company, and a trailblazing woman leader at the forefront of AI-driven customer engagement and digital communications. With 28+ years of experience across IT, telecom, cloud communications, and enterprise technology, she has led Karix's growth in conversational AI, OTT, and omnichannel innovation, while forging strategic partnerships with global technology leaders including Google, Meta, and True caller. A recognized voice on AI, digital transformation, and the future of customer experience, Sonia brings a unique blend of deep technology expertise and business leadership. As a champion for women in tech, she is shaping the next generation of intelligent, scalable communication solutions while inspiring, greater diversity in technology leadership.

name: Ms. Sorcha Sullivan-Williams
jobTitle: Head of Digital Assets, International Developed Markets

name: Ms. Sukhvinder Kaur
bio: Ms. Sukhvinder Kaur is a seasoned professional Banker who started her career with State Bank of India in the year 1991 as a probationary officer. She has been a part of State Bank of India, India’s oldest and largest Banking group , for more than 3 decades now. She currently serves as The Deputy Managing Director Operations: Channel Management, spearheading various operational channels with in the Bank including, Anytime Channel, Financial inclusion, Contact Centre and Third Party management. These channels are central to the Bank’s Strategic vision of optimising operational efficiency and reducing costs.

name: Ms. Surbhe Sharma
bio: Ms. Surbhe S Sharma brings over a decade of experience in building and managing financial products and partnerships across lending and credit card businesses. Prior to her current role, she led strategic partnerships and business development for the Used Car Finance segment and served as Product Head for MSME loan products at Bajaj Finance. She has also worked with GE SBI Card (a former joint venture between GE Capital and SBI) in the co-branded credit card space. She holds dual postgraduate degrees: a PG Diploma in Management in Marketing from Christ University, Bengaluru and an MBA in International Business from FH-WS University of Applied Sciences, Germany.

name: Ms. Taneia Bhardwaj
bio: Taneia Bhardwaj is the South Asia Expansion Lead at Wise and a Board Director of Wise Payments India, where she leads the company's growth and market expansion strategy across the region. She works at the intersection of fintech, regulation and financial infrastructure, partnering with banks, regulators and ecosystem players to build and scale Wise's presence in South Asia. In India, Taneia has spearheaded the launch of the Wise Travel Card and outward remittance services, while also playing a pivotal role in securing the company's Payment Aggregator Cross-Border (PA-CB) licence. Prior to Wise, she led the retail and SME business at Instarem India (Nium), driving partnerships and growth. Before pivoting to fintech, Taneia spent over a decade in business journalism as a prime-time news Anchor and Senior Editor at leading networks, including ET NOW and CNBC-TV18.

name: Ms. Tanya Naik
bio: Tanya Naik is the Head of Online and Omnichannel Business at Pine Labs. She has been steadily involved in building the digital payments infrastructure throughout her professional career. She was earlier a part of the founding team of PayPal in India and has more than 18 years of experience in the banking and payments sector. Tanya has also served as the Director – Payments, India, and Cross Border Markets, where she was entrusted with the responsibility of ensuring seamless cross-trade payments across 100+ markets.

name: Prof. Aashish Goel
jobTitle: Professor, Management Science and Engineering, of Computer Science

name: Prof. G Sivakumar
bio: Prof. G. Sivakumar has been on the faculty of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Bombay, since 1991. His core research interests are in the applications of Logic in diverse areas of Computer Science such as Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering and Network Security. He has applied his research to design and verification of safety critical real-time systems. Such systems include computer based control systems used in nuclear reactors, space, avionics, process-control and robotics. Prof. Sivakumar has published over 25 papers in reputed journals and conferences. He has supervised 10 Ph.D. Theses and over 100 Master's theses.

name: Shri Kalyanaraman Rajaraman
bio: Shri K. Rajaraman is Chairperson of IFSCA since August 2023, after nearly 35 years in senior roles in the Government of India and Tamil Nadu. A former IAS officer, he last served as Secretary, Department of Telecommunication. He holds degrees in Electronics & Communication, MBA, and Economics. He has led key roles in investment, infrastructure, tax, and finance, and was MD of Chennai Metro during its early construction phase.

name: Shri Nitin Gadkari
jobTitle: Hon'ble Minister for Roads Transport & Highways

org: Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India

name: Shri Sanjay Lohiya
org: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
bio: Shri Sanjay Lohiya, an IAS Officer of 1994 batch (Assam Meghalaya cadre), has joined Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance as Special Secretary and took over as Secretary, Department of Financial Services w.e.f. 1.6.2026. Prior to joining as Special Secretary in DFS, he was Additional Secretary in Ministry of Mines. He joined Indian Administrative Service (IAS) after graduating from St. Stephen's College, Delhi University. Before joining as Additional Secretary, Ministry of Mines, he held various positions, which included Principal Secretary to Chief Minister, Government of Assam, Joint Secretary in Ministry of Agriculture, Director in PMO, etc.
